Use product and operational data to understand adoption, friction, and impact — and use those insights to set your own priorities. Likely on your second or third PM role , with experience shipping real product and working closely with engineers. Strong product judgment, prioritization, and communication skills. Comfort operating in ambiguous environments where external systems are poorly documented, fragmented, or constantly changing. Genuine interest in AI product development, including how to evaluate model outputs, design human-in-the-loop workflows, and understand where LLMs break down. What You'll Need To Learn Quickly: How our platform automates benefit verification and prior authorization — the healthcare context that shapes every product decision. The external systems our product touches: EHRs, payer portals, PBM formularies, and NCPDP transaction standards. Our codebase, data model, and AI workflows — where quality is strong and where there's room to improve. Bonus Points: Experience working on AI-powered products or LLM-based workflows in production. Comfort with SQL, basic data analysis, or API concepts. Experience prototyping or shipping product changes directly with AI coding tools (Claude Code, Cursor, etc.). Experience in an early-stage startup where you had to move quickly and wear multiple hats. What We Offer: $160,000 – $200,000 base salary plus meaningful early-stage equity. Health, dental, and vision coverage, plus flexible PTO. High-end workstation and tooling budget. # Senior Manager, Performance Marketing, Emerging Products

Salary: 138600-192000 per yearLocation:USCompany:Upstart

## Description:

**About Upstart**

At Upstart, we’re united by a mission that matters: to radically reduce the cost and complexity of borrowing for all Americans. Every day, we bring creativity, experimentation, and advanced AI to reshape access to credit, helping millions move forward financially with clarity and confidence.

As the leading AI lending marketplace, we partner with banks and credit unions to expand access to affordable credit through technology that’s both radically intelligent and deeply human. Our platform runs over one million predictions per borrower using more than 3,000 signals, powering smarter, fairer decisions for millions of customers. But the numbers only hint at the impact. Every idea, every voice, and every contribution moves us closer to a world where credit never stands between people and their financial progress.

We’re proudly digital-first, giving most Upstarters the flexibility to do their best work from wherever they thrive, alongside teammates across 80+ cities in the US and Canada. Digital-first doesn’t mean distant. We’re intentional about in-person connection through team onsites, planning sessions, and moments that spark creativity and trust. And whether you choose to work primarily from home or collaborate in-person from one of our offices in Columbus, Austin, the Bay Area, or New York City, you’ll have the support to work in the way that works best for you.

If you’re energized by tackling meaningful problems, excited to innovate with purpose, and motivated by work that truly matters, we’d love to hear from you.

**The Team:**

Upstart’s **Digital Marketing team** drives scalable, data-driven customer acquisition across our lending products via performance marketing channels. We design, execute, and optimize digital media strategies that connect consumers to credit at the moments that matter most. Through rigorous experimentation, channel optimization, and disciplined CAC management, the team plays a critical role in fueling Upstart’s growth while maintaining strong unit economics for the business.

**As the Senior Manager, Performance Marketing, Emerging Products and channels at Upstart,** you will own and scale paid digital acquisition across key channels including SEM, paid social, display, and emerging performance channels. **This zero-to-one role** with the opportunity to build Upstart’s Home Equity Line of Credit (HELOC) performance marketing engine from the ground up.

You will be responsible for day-to-day media buying and optimization in platform, including campaign setup, keyword and audience management, bidding, budgeting, creative testing, and landing page optimization.You will partner closely with Product Marketing, Analytics, Creative, and the HELOC General Manager to launch new campaigns, unlock new audiences, and rapidly test and iterate across messaging, targeting, and channel mix.

This role offers exceptional ownership and visibility, with the chance to make a material impact on one of Upstart’s newest and most strategic product lines while laying the foundation for long-term growth.

**How you’ll make an impact**

- **Own and scale HELOC media buying across SEM, paid social, display, and emerging performance channels**, managing strategy, execution, and optimization end to end.
- **Scale Upstart’s HELOC performance marketing engine**, establishing channel strategy, testing frameworks, and best practices in a zero-to-one environment.
- **Drive efficient, incremental customer acquisition** by continuously optimizing bids, budgets, audiences, and creative to hit volume, CPA, and ROI targets.
- **Design and run rigorous experimentation programs** across keywords, audiences, creatives, and formats to unlock scalable growth opportunities and new channels.
- **Manage and forecast significant media budgets**, balancing growth and efficiency while adapting quickly to performance trends and market dynamics.

**Minimum Qualifications**

- **5+ years of experience in performance marketing or digital media buying, with a strong focus on SEM and additional experience across paid social and/or display.**
- **Proven track record of owning large-scale acquisition programs, managing significant monthly budgets, and driving measurable growth against CPA, ROI, and volume targets.**
- **Deep hands-on expertise in paid search**, including keyword strategy, bid management, ad copy testing, and landing page optimization.
- **Strong analytical skills,** with the ability to interpret performance data, design experiments, and make data-driven decisions in ambiguous environments.
- Ability to thrive in a fast-paced, high-growth environment where adaptability and problem-solving are key

**Preferred Qualifications**

- Experience operating in highly regulated or longer consideration cycle vertical (e.g., financial services, fintech, lending, insurance, marketplaces).
- Experience launching and scaling new channels or products from zero to one, with comfort operating in ambiguity and building an acquisition funnel from scratch.
- Experience working closely with product and engineering teams to improve landing pages, funnels, and on-site conversion through testing and iteration.

**Position location** This role is available in the following locations: Remote

**Time zone requirements** The team operates on the East/West coast time zones.

**Travel requirements** As a digital first company, the majority of your work can be accomplished remotely. The majority of our employees can live and work anywhere in the U.S but are encouraged to to still spend high quality time in-person collaborating via regular onsites. The in-person sessions’ cadence varies depending on the team and role; most teams meet once or twice per quarter for 2-4 consecutive days at a time.

# Senior Program Manager, Growth Marketing & Conversion

Location:Highland Beach, FLCompany:Mdvip

## Description:

**MDVIP: Transforming Primary Care, One Patient at a Time**

MDVIP is a national leader in personalized healthcare, empowering over 425,000 members to achieve their health and wellness goals through a network of more than 1,400 concierge primary care physicians. Our program emphasizes preventive medicine, offering comprehensive screenings, advanced diagnostics, and individualized wellness plans. Recognized as a Great Place to Work® since 2018, MDVIP is committed to excellence in patient care and employee satisfaction.

**Role Summary**

The Organic Growth team owns SEO, content, conversion rate optimization (CRO), and the website product. This year, the website roadmap is committed to executing a serious CRO program, standing up new content infrastructure, and working through technical SEO improvements. However, this role has a bigger mandate than just organic traffic -- we’re looking for a Lead-to-Sale Sr. Manager who has the crucial responsibility of improving sales rate across all channels that drive leads to land on the website. The website is our primary vehicle for communicating the membership value proposition and convincing a lead to enroll, so this role guides the success of a cross-functional taskforce — spanning Marketing, Sales, CRO, and Product — that runs special initiatives to improve how effectively that value prop converts into paid annual memberships.

You’ll own the critical middle and lower end of our growth funnel: converting marketing-generated leads into paid annual memberships. This is an individual-contributor role sitting at the intersection of marketing and sales, responsible for understanding processes end-to-end and optimizing how they turn interest into enrollment.

This is a revenue-accountable role. We measure success in new member enrollments. The ideal candidate combines a sales-driven mindset with marketing fluency — comfortable owning conversion metrics across every channel, understands the unique needs and mindset of patients exploring the benefits of membership medicine, and advocates for experimentation in website messaging & pipeline process steps that translate into incremental enrollment lift.

If you are an individual who doesn’t shy away from improving complex processes and has experience driving initiatives that close the gap between lead generation and revenue across teams that don't report to you, then we want to hear from you.

**Key Responsibilities**

- Own the lead-to-sale conversion funnel, from marketing qualified lead through close (paid enrollment in membership) across every acquisition channel — organic, paid, local, referral, and beyond — not just leads sourced by the Organic Growth team.
- Improve the sales rate (lead-to-enrolled-member conversion) for all leads landing on the website.
- Identify friction points in the lead-to-enrollment journey — website, sales process, or handoffs between them – and drive taskforce initiatives with Marketing, Analytics, Sales Ops, CRO, and Physician Product teams to resolve them.
- Manage a cross-functional roadmap of lead-to-sale initiatives by defining scope, aligning on prioritization, and excuting enhancement experiments with measurements that improve how well the website & other channels communicate the membership value prop and convert leads through interrelated touchpoints along the journey to conversion.
- Partner with the Organic Growth team (SEO, Content, CRO) and paid acquisition owners to ensure lead capture & quality, on-site messaging, and page experience support conversion goals across all channels.
- Partner with Membership Sales leadership to increase lead-to-sale conversion, collaborating on value-prop messaging and website-to-sales contact center agent handoffs, follow-up cadence, and contact journey mapping to support close rates across channels.
- Collaborate with Lifecycle Marketing/CRM team team to define customer journey and optimize lead nurture outreach streams through owned channels (calls, email, SMS) to convert them within target response-time and follow-up windows.
- Track and report on sales-rate KPIs by channel (lead response time, conversion rate, sales cycle length, revenue per lead) and maintain accurate pipeline records.
- Heavily influence CRM workflows (e.g., Salesforce, Marketo) related to lead status, stage progression, and reporting.
- Use Marketing Analytics tools to forecast weekly/monthly/quarterly membership sales and report against targets to marketing and executive leadership.

**Key Competencies**

- Revenue accountability: owns the lead-to-sale funnel and ties initiative prioritization decisions to member enrollment.
- Cross-functional stakeholder management: builds trust and drives alignment across Marketing Channel Owners, Sales, and Analytics without formal authority, resolving competing priorities to keep taskforce initiatives moving from idea to shipped.
- Program management discipline: runs cross-functional workstreams with clear milestones, owners, and status reporting, using structured project management practices and thorough documentation to keep initiatives moving without relying on informal follow-up.

Requirements

**Qualifications:**

**Required Qualifications**

- \[3–5\]+ years of experience in growth marketing, demand generation, or conversion rate optimization, with at least 3 years focused specifically on lead-to-sale or lead-to-revenue funnel ownership ideally within healthcare, wellness, subscription, or membership-based business models.
- Demonstrated success managing initiatives across multiple acquisition channels simultaneously (organic, paid, local/referral) rather than a single channel.
- Proven track record improving lead-to-sale/lead-to-close conversion rates in a business with a defined sales team or contact center handoff (not purely self-serve e-commerce).
- Excellent communication skills, both written and verbal, with experience evaluating options for value-add, assigning prioritization, and conveying sales impact across and up the organization.
- Strong analytical skills — comfortable building and interpreting funnel/conversion reports
- Proficient in Microsoft Office applications, with advanced skills in Excel and PowerPoint.
- Experience with marketing automation platforms (Marketo, etc.), and analytics tools (GA4, Looker Studio).

**Our Values**

- **Integrity**– Doing what is right in all things

- **Service**– Laboring for others with humility and care
- **Excellence**– Delivering extraordinary performance and results with humility
- **Journey**– Embracing our past and planning for our future with faith

**Description**

**The Senior Digital Advertising Manager, Retail Media Paid Search will play an essential role in defining, managing, and communicating retail paid search strategies for large, complex clients across multiple retailers (including Walmart, Sam’s Club, Amazon, Target, and Kroger). While this role is primarily dedicated to Paid Search (sponsored product campaigns, keyword strategy, bid management, and performance optimizations), it also serves as a strategic advisor/consultant across programmatic display and paid social channels.**

**In addition to planning, executing, and reporting on search campaigns, this full-funnel leader is expected to consistently focus on client opportunities and threats. Day-to-day activities include hands-on execution of Paid Search campaigns (optimizations, keyword analysis, bid adjustments), strategic planning, and managing client/team relationships. This role is a balance between execution and strategy.**

**The Senior Advertising Manager will also inform internal client teams on important Paid Search strategies and best practices in retail media. The ideal candidate will work to make sense of the many moving pieces of the sponsored advertising ecosystem, translating them into actionable strategic choices.**

**For this role we prefer that candidates are based out of the following states: AL, AR, AZ, CT, FL, GA, IA, ID, IL, IN, KS, KY, MA, MD, MI, MN, MO, MS, NE, NV, NC, NJ, OH, OK, OR, PA, SC, TN, TX, UT, VA, VT, WA, or WI.**

**Responsibilities**

- Inform strategy, planning, and own execution for clients’ Paid Search advertising campaigns
- Build, maintain, and report on search campaigns aligned to client goals
- Optimize and maintain campaigns, including analyzing current results to inform tactical changes
- Collaborate across internal account teams, external client teams, and retailer media group stakeholders to maximize performance
- Serve as a strategic advisor on holistic retail media strategies inclusive of search, programmatic display (e.g., AMZ DSP, DV360, TTD), and paid social (e.g., Meta)
- Guide clients and teams through clear and concise communication, both written and verbal
- Apply strategic thinking, adaptability, and insightful analysis to identify areas of opportunity and deliver optimized results
- Provide weekly reporting with analysis and insights of prior week’s activity and campaign results-to-date

**Requirements**

- 4–5+ years of experience managing retail Paid Search campaigns across retail media networks (ex. Amazon, Walmart Connect, Criteo, Instacart, or similar retail media networks)
- Must have hands-on experience executing campaigns on Walmart or Amazon
- Enjoys fast-paced, changing environment with evolving challenges
- Strategic thinker capable of analyzing search performance data to refine campaign execution
- Self-starter with a drive to innovate and improve processes and results
- Experience managing multiple stakeholders and achieving consensus on goals and objectives
- Ability to take ownership and work autonomously with little supervision
- Strong multitasking skills with ability to prioritize and organize multiple projects
- Exceptional attention to detail with ability to connect small changes to larger performance outcomes
- Ability to translate large amounts of performance data into concise and actionable takeaways
- Clear verbal and written communication skills
- Adept at learning new advertising platforms and tools
- Proficient in Microsoft Office, with a focus on Excel
- Willingness to travel

**Preferred**

- Experience developing Paid Search advertising strategies across multiple retailers (e.g., Walmart, Sam’s Club, Amazon, Target, Kroger)
- Experience with holistic strategy in account management or as a strategic advisor, inclusive of search, display (Amazon DSP, DV360, TTD), and social (ex. Meta)
- 1–2 years of people management experience

Harvest Group understands that investing in our people and culture are vital to successfully attracting and retaining top talent. Our goal is to offer competitive compensation and benefits packages to all employees. Each year, we invest time to research and evaluate how our packages line up with the latest market dynamics.

# Senior PPC Media Specialist

Location:Cranbury, NJCompany:Infragistics

## Description:

The Senior PPC / Paid Media Specialist

will own and scale paid acquisition programs across search and paid media channels for multiple brands. This is a hands-on individual contributor role that blends strategic planning with day-to-day execution.

The role operates with a high degree of autonomy, owning campaign execution, optimization, and performance management while aligning closely with Product Marketing on messaging, positioning, and priorities.

Success is measured by lead quality, cost efficiency, and contribution to pipeline.

Key Responsibilities

Paid Media Strategy & Planning

- Own, develop and evolve paid media strategies across Google Ads, LinkedIn Ads, Bing, Amazon Ads, and paid social
- Build and manage campaigns for lead generation, paid social, ABM, retargeting, and product-led growth
- Recommend budget allocation and reallocation based on performance, seasonality, and business priorities
- Identify whitespace opportunities across keywords, audiences, platforms, and ad formats
- Align paid media efforts to funnel stages and campaign goals

Demand Generation & Pipeline Impact

- Drive MQLs, SQLs, and pipeline contribution, not just traffic
- Partner with Sales and RevOps to ensure strong lead quality and attribution
- Optimize toward CPL, CAC, conversion rate, and pipeline velocity

Campaign Execution & Optimization

- Build, launch, and manage campaigns end-to-end across platforms
- Own campaign structure, targeting, bidding strategies, budgets, and pacing
- Continuously optimize for CPL, conversion rate, lead quality, and scale
- Optimize campaigns with prioritizes tests based on impact, effort, and learning potential

Keyword Strategy & Search Performance

- Conduct in-depth keyword research to identify high-intent, high-ROI opportunities
- Manage match types, negatives, and keyword expansion
- Optimize campaigns for relevance, efficiency, and quality score

Ad Copy, Creative & Testing

- Partner with Product Marketing to write, test, and refine ad copy across search, social, display, and video formats
- Partner with design and content teams to develop effective creative
- Run structured tests on messaging, formats, offers, and audiences

Landing Page & Conversion Optimization

- Partner with Product Marketing to improve landing page performance
- Ensure alignment between ad intent, messaging, and user experience
- Use performance data to recommend page-level improvements

Remarketing & Full-Funnel Programs

- Build and manage remarketing and retargeting campaigns
- Support ABM, product-led, and sales-led motions with tailored audience strategies
- Improve efficiency by re-engaging known users and accounts

Competitive & Performance Analysis

- Monitor competitor PPC activity to inform keyword, creative, and bidding decisions
- Translate performance data into clear, actionable recommendations
- Maintain dashboards and reports for leadership and stakeholders

Measurement, Attribution & Reporting

- Own paid media measurement across platforms, analytics tools, and CRM
- Ensure accurate conversion tracking, offline conversion imports, and attribution alignment
- Report out on OKR progression weekly within team and monthly to key stakeholders
- Clearly communicate performance, insights, and recommendations to non-paid stakeholders
- Translate data into concise narratives for leadership
- Proactively flag risks, opportunities, and performance shifts

Portfolio & Priority Management

- Manage paid media programs across multiple brands with distinct ICPs and funnel motions
- Balance short-term performance with long-term growth and experimentation
- Make informed tradeoffs across brands, channels, and campaigns based on business impact

Qualifications

Required Qualifications

- 5–7+ years managing PPC campaigns (B2B SaaS preferred)
- Hands-on experience with Google Ads and LinkedIn Ads
- Deep experience with advanced bidding strategies (tROAS, tCPA, value-based bidding)
- Experience with audience layering, exclusions, and first-party data activation
- Strong understanding of demand generation funnels and lead qualification
- Experience optimizing campaigns based on downstream metrics (MQL → SQL → Revenue)
- Comfortable working with data, dashboards, and performance reporting

Preferred Qualifications

- Experience with ABM platforms (e.g., 6sense, Demandbase)
- Familiarity with marketing automation and CRM tools (HubSpot, Marketo, Salesforce Marketing Cloud)
- Experience supporting product-led growth or free trial motions
- Understanding of SEO, CRO, and landing page optimization
- Experience managing multiple brand monthly ad budgets

Responsibilities: Specific duties are intended to describe activities that support the summary above. The list is not all inclusive – other duties may be required to cover the breadth and depth of the position.

**1\. Strategic Leadership & Planning**

- Set the digital marketing and marketing operations strategy and annual/quarterly roadmap in partnership with the Director of Marketing, translating Malco’s growth goals into channel, systems, and resourcing priorities for this scope.
- Own budget planning and investment recommendations for digital marketing and marketing operations — tooling, agencies, paid, and future headcount — and make the case for tradeoffs and new investment rather than simply executing a pre-set budget.
- Act as the senior decision-maker for day-to-day digital and marketing-ops priorities and tradeoffs
- Own vendor and agency selection and management within this scope (web development, SEO, paid social, martech platforms), including negotiating scope and holding partners accountable to results.

**2\. Website & Digital Experience**

- Own strategy, roadmap, and performance for all Malco web properties (DTC site(s), brand pages) — UX, conversion, and technical health.
- Partner with agencies/developers on site builds, updates, and maintenance; act as the internal owner who sets priorities and evaluates output.
- Ensure site content (product, technical, regulatory, label) stays synced with the PIM/knowledge base so what’s live on-site is always accurate.

**3\. SEO, AEO & Organic Discovery**

- Own Malco’s organic search and AI-search (AEO) strategy across brand and product content — the goal is that when detailers search or ask AI tools about detailing chemicals, Malco brands surface.
- Conduct keyword, topic, and prompt research and translate it into a content and technical roadmap that Content Studio and this role execute against.
- Own on-page and technical SEO (site structure, metadata, schema markup, page speed) and monitor how Malco content performs in AI answer engines (ChatGPT, Perplexity, Google AI Overviews) as that channel grows.

**4\. Marketing Technology Stack & Data Infrastructure**

- Own the architecture, configuration, and integrations of Malco’s marketing technology stack: website/CMS, digital asset management, content management, marketing automation (HubSpot, Klaviyo, or equivalent), project management (Asana), analytics, SEO tooling, and AI tooling.
- Work alongside IT to support our product information management (PIM) infrastructure as the single source of truth for product copy, specifications, application data, regulatory/label content, and creative assets across Amazon, Shopify, distributor portals, sell sheets, and international markets.
- Build and maintain integrations between systems — product data flowing from ERP to CMS to Amazon; assets flowing from DAM to email, social, and web; campaign data flowing from execution platforms to dashboards — and govern access, permissions, and data hygiene across all marketing platforms.
- Own the architecture and configuration of marketing automation platforms — data model, segmentation logic, lifecycle flows, deliverability, and integrations.
- Evaluate, recommend, and onboard new marketing technology as the team’s needs evolve.

**5\. AI Workflows & Knowledge Management**

- Build the prompt library, AI workflows, and automation systems that allow the marketing team to produce a high volume of on-brand content across four brands without proportional headcount growth.
- Build and maintain Malco’s proprietary marketing knowledge base — brand voice, technical product knowledge, application expertise, competitive positioning, and regulatory language — as a structured, version-controlled system that AI workflows draw from.
- Design the create-once, scale-everywhere workflow that turns a single video shoot, photo set, or product launch into ten or more channel-ready assets across web, social, email, distributor kits, and sales enablement.
- Continuously test, refine, and document AI workflows; train the team to use them effectively without ceding editorial judgment.

**6\. Marketing Intelligence & Voice-of-Customer Systems**

- Build the listening infrastructure that captures continuous signal from the professional detailing community — industry forums, social media, product reviews, search/AI-search trends, and competitor content.
- Design systems for synthesizing field and distributor feedback into structured intelligence the marketing team acts on, and build competitive intelligence capabilities that track content, channel programs, product launches, and community building.

**7\. Distributor Enablement Infrastructure & Sales-Marketing Data Integration**

- Build and maintain the technical infrastructure that gets marketing assets, product data, sales tools, and campaign content into distributor portals, syndication feeds, and partner systems.
- Architect content and product data syndication so that new launches, updated specifications, and marketing campaigns flow to distributor channels without manual rekeying.
- Partner with Sales Operations and IT on distributor-facing systems and CRM ownership where accountabilities overlap.

**8\. Performance Dashboards & Marketing Reporting**

- Build the marketing performance dashboard, including website and SEO/AEO performance alongside automation and distributor metrics.
- Define and govern marketing key performance indicators and the data sources that feed them; instrument campaigns and channels so attribution is possible.
- Surface insights rather than just numbers — the dashboard should tell a story without requiring extensive interpretation.

**9\. Team Leadership & Scaling**

- Assess team workload and make the case for a Marketing Operations/Digital Implementer or Junior Associate hire when volume justifies it; scope, interview, and onboard that hire once approved.
- Build a team structure and workflow that stays lean without becoming a bottleneck as Malco scales

**10\. Internal Enablement & Documentation**

- Train the marketing team on the systems and workflows you build, and keep them clearly documented so the team can rely on them with confidence over time.
- Be the internal expert the team turns to when a system, website, SEO, or social question blocks them.
- Continuously identify opportunities to remove manual work and increase output through automation and AI.

Education: Bachelor’s Degree in Marketing, Operations, Business Systems, or related field, or equivalent professional experience.

Experience / Requirements:

- 5+ years in a role spanning digital marketing and marketing operations/technology — website management, SEO, marketing automation, or a comparable systems-and-channel hybrid — ideally at a multi-brand or multi-channel consumer goods, B2B manufacturing, or DTC business.
- Proven track record of setting and owning strategy for a function — not just executing against someone else's plan — including budget and investment recommendations, roadmap-setting, and prioritization tradeoffs.
- Prior experience managing at least one direct report and/or agency/vendor relationships as the senior accountable owner.
- Hands-on experience owning a website/CMS (Shopify, WordPress, or equivalent), including content, UX, and conversion optimization.
- Demonstrated SEO experience (technical, on-page, content) and working knowledge of how AI answer engines source and surface content (AEO); comfort with tools such as Google Search Console, Ahrefs/SEMrush, and GA4.
- Comfort and demonstrated proficiency working with AI platforms (Claude, ChatGPT, Gemini) at an advanced workflow design level, not just a daily-use level.
- Demonstrated experience building and deploying AI workflows for marketing content or operations at scale.
- Hands-on experience configuring and integrating marketing automation platforms (HubSpot, Klaviyo, Marketo, or equivalent).
- Experience implementing or managing product information management (PIM) systems or comparable structured product data architectures — Plytix, Akeneo, Salsify, or custom-built equivalents.
- Experience building marketing performance dashboards using tools such as Looker, Power BI, Tableau, GA4, or HubSpot Reporting.
- Strong systems thinking — able to design a website, workflow, or content system that survives the team that uses it.
- Self-directed working style — able to operate as strategist, architect, and builder with limited day-to-day supervision, and to manage or direct at least one other team member.
- Strong project leadership and stakeholder management — able to drive change across a team that is not entirely your direct reports.
- Experience in the automotive aftermarket, detailing, or marine industries is preferred but not required.

Designers are required to mock up every pixel. At Ashby, it’s different. We believe individual contributors do their best work when they have a deep understanding of the end user and the business, and ownership of the solution. **What to expect as a Senior Manager, Paid Media**

As Senior Manager, Paid Media, you will own day-to-day paid media strategy, planning, buying, execution, and optimization across paid search and paid social for Climate First Bancorp, Climate First Bank, OneEthos, and future portfolio companies. You will translate growth objectives into channel plans, campaign architecture, audience and keyword strategies, budgets, forecasts, and tests - then personally build and manage the campaigns that bring those plans to life. - **Paid Media Strategy & Planning -** Develop integrated paid search and social strategies aligned to business priorities, audiences, funnel stages, geographies, budgets, and success measures. Analyze funnel performance, CPL, CAC, ROAS, conversion quality, and other business outcomes; translate findings into clear actions for leadership and channel partners.

- **Mission, Risk & Responsible Media -** Apply our mission and values to media choices while following bank policies, privacy requirements, platform rules, fair-lending considerations, and brand-safety standards. Partner with Compliance, Legal, IT, and subject-matter experts so targeting, claims, disclosures, data use, and campaigns are accurate, approved, secure, and responsible.

**We’re looking for a performance-driven Senior Media Buyer who knows how to turn advertising dollars into measurable business growth.** This is a role for a strategic thinker, relentless optimizer, and results-oriented marketer who understands that every campaign must deliver a return.

The ideal candidate brings deep experience developing, executing, and optimizing paid media campaigns across multiple platforms, including Meta, Google, TikTok, LinkedIn, and Reddit. You know how to identify the right audiences, build compelling campaigns, analyze performance, and make data-driven decisions that continuously improve results.

Success is measured by the numbers that matter - Customer Acquisition Cost (CAC), Cost Per Lead (CPL), and Return on Ad Spend (ROAS). You understand how to balance scale with efficiency, manage budgets with discipline, and translate campaign performance into actionable business insights.

We're not looking for someone who simply manages advertising campaigns. **We're looking for someone who challenges assumptions, tests aggressively, identifies opportunities, and takes ownership of outcomes.**

If you thrive in a fast-paced environment where performance matters, experimentation is encouraged, and results speak louder than impressions, we want to meet you.

**Job Responsibilities**

- Proficient in buying media on the following platforms: Meta, Google, TikTok, LinkedIn, and Reddit managing all stages of the campaign life (setup, launch, optimization, evaluation, reporting)
- Manage campaigns across multiple platforms, with large advertising budgets daily while monitoring performance and adjusting strategy as necessary
- Develop comprehensive media strategies and plans aligned with campaign objectives and KPIs cross multiple channels and platforms to drive ticket sales, product sales, engagement, and brand growth
- Closely monitor the performance of ongoing campaigns and key marketing metric using analytics tools (GA4), identify opportunities for advanced optimization, and help oversee the testing of new strategies to improve results and ROAS, CAC, and CPL
- Continuously optimize campaigns through A/B testing, bid strategies, and audience segmentation to maximize performance
- Analyze campaign metrics, find key insights and explain performance through in-depth reporting
- Implement sophisticated audience segmentation and retargeting strategies
- Produce regular reports on performance, interpret data, establish benchmarks, and provide actionable plans and recommendations based on insights
- Do in market and audience research to inform media decisions
- Manage, optimize and track budgets
- Assist the accounting department with media spent, invoicing and billing for paid media
- Identify creative opportunities for ads, work with copywriters, designers, and video editors to create paid media assets
- Collaborate with cross-functional teams (creative, content, and product teams) to align ad creatives and messaging with brand goals
- Assist in the curation and creation of high performing ad content using photo, video, graphics
- Test the performance of ad creatives and copy, page design, and other campaign elements to improve results
- Maintain knowledge of emerging trends, industry best practices and new technologies to stay ahead of the competition

**Job Requirements**

- 7+ years of experience managing campaigns and ad strategies either in-house or at an agency
- Proven track record of building and optimizing campaigns for Paid Social, SEM/Paid Search, and/or Programmatic Buys (Preferred Platforms: Meta, Google, LinkedIn, and TikTok)
- Experienced in maximum results out of full-funnel digital advertising, DTC, B2B, and lead generation-focused
- Experience using direct response and lead generation advertising strategies successfully
- Able to work with tracking pixels, conversion APls and UTMs - understanding their functionality, creation, and implementation
- Thorough understanding of landing page best practices for conversion goals and click attribution
- Strong analytical skills with a deep understanding of data-driven performance marketing and the ability to interpret key metrics
- Highly proficient in Excel and Google Sheets
- Proficiency in Shopify and a solid understanding of e-commerce conversion funnels
- Familiar with Shopify reports, GA4, LookerStudio, or other data visualization software
- Experience or understanding of DSP's and programmatic buying is a plus
- Experience in events industry is a plus

Compensation: Salary + Performance-Based Bonus, Comprehensive Benefits Package. Final compensation will be determined based on experience and skills and may vary from the range listed above.

# Senior Digital Marketing & Analytics Manager

Salary: 105000-150000 per yearLocation:San Diego, CACompany:Cetera Financial Group

## Description:

**Description**

The Marketing Analytics Manager, Marketing Operations, will lead the development of scalable measurement, reporting, and insights capabilities that strengthen marketing performance and support firm growth objectives. This role is responsible for establishing a unified marketing KPI framework, managing recurring reporting cadences, developing executive-level dashboards, and delivering actionable insights that inform strategic decisions across Marketing, Sales, Finance, and senior leadership. The ideal candidate combines analytical rigor, business acumen, and strong stakeholder partnership to improve performance visibility, enhance operational discipline, and enable data-driven planning across marketing initiatives, spend, and project portfolios.

**What You'll Do:**

- Provide day-to-day direction for offshore analytics resources supporting performance measurement, digital analytics, data visualization, segmentation, predictive modeling, and marketing insights.
- Lead end-to-end analytical projects, including test design, data collection and preparation, modeling, visualization, interpretation, and communication of findings.
- Translate complex data into actionable recommendations that improve acquisition, retention, channel mix, marketing ROI, LTV/CAC, NPS, and overall marketing performance.
- Develop and maintain standardized weekly, monthly, and quarterly reports, executive dashboards, and QBR materials covering lead generation, digital engagement, channel performance, earned impressions, risks, opportunities, and key marketing metrics.
- Build forecasting models, predictive analytics, and actionable segmentation to support marketing and sales planning, targeted communications, journey analysis, prioritization, and strategy.
- Establish and maintain data governance practices that improve accuracy, consistency, documentation, reliability, and stakeholder confidence across marketing and sales data.
- Partner with Marketing, Sales, Finance, and cross-functional stakeholders to define requirements, align on a unified KPI framework, and deliver analytics solutions tied to business priorities.
- Evaluate analytics tools, processes, and resources to identify opportunities for automation, efficiency, scalability, and adoption of emerging analytics capabilities and best practices.
- Develop data-informed perspectives on industry trends, competitor activity, brand health, and reputational risk using media, social, brand, and performance data.

**What You Need to Have:**

- Bachelor’s degree in Marketing, Business, Analytics, Statistics, Economics, Finance, Computer Science, or a related field; an equivalent combination of education and experience may be considered.
- Seven or more years of experience in marketing analytics, business analytics, data insights, performance measurement, or a related analytical function.
- Experience developing KPI frameworks, dashboards, reporting cadences, and executive-ready insights that support business decision-making.
- Demonstrated experience with advanced analytics, data visualization, and reporting tools, including Excel and PowerPoint; experience with SQL, Power BI, Tableau, or similar tools preferred.
- Experience partnering with cross-functional teams to translate business objectives into measurable reporting, analysis, and recommendations.
- Advanced proficiency with analytics, reporting, and visualization tools, including Excel and one or more platforms such as SQL, Power BI, Tableau, Python, R, or similar tools.
- Strong understanding of marketing performance measurement, KPI frameworks, campaign analytics, attribution, channel performance, ROI, LTV/CAC, funnel metrics, and executive reporting cadences.
- Ability to translate complex data into clear, concise, executive-ready insights, dashboards, business review materials, and recommendations for audiences with varying technical backgrounds.
- Working knowledge of CRM, marketing automation, web analytics, and MarTech platforms such as Salesforce, Marketo, Google Analytics, or related systems.
- Working knowledge of statistics, experimental design, A/B testing, regression analysis, segmentation, and predictive modeling.
- Ability to establish and maintain data governance practices that improve reporting accuracy, consistency, documentation, and stakeholder confidence.
- Strong cross-functional collaboration and communication skills, with the ability to align Marketing, Sales, Finance, and other partners around shared metrics, reporting needs, and decision-making.
- Self-starter with sound business judgment, strong attention to detail, intellectual curiosity, and the ability to operate effectively in a fast-paced, matrixed environment.

**What's Nice to Have:**

- Master’s degree in quantitative, business, marketing analytics, or related field preferred; equivalent experience will be considered.
- Experience with data cloud, warehouse, or analytics platforms such as Snowflake, Databricks, Azure, SQL, Power BI, Tableau, Salesforce, Marketo, Google Analytics, Hootsuite, AdRoll, Sprout Social, or similar tools.
- Experience developing executive-level dashboards, KPI scorecards, and business review materials for senior leadership audiences.
- Financial services, wealth management, or advisor marketing experience preferred.
- Experience analyzing social, earned media, and brand health performance, including engagement, audience growth, share of voice, message pull-through, sentiment, and competitive positioning.
- Ability to interpret third-party brand research and apply findings to marketing and communications strategy.

**Travel Requirements:** Up to (10%)

**Compensation:**

The base salary range for this role in Dallas, TX & San Diego, CA is $105,000-$150,000, plus a competitive performance-based bonus. Base salary depends on a wide array of factors, including but not limited to skill set, years and depth of experience, certifications, and location. Salary range may also differ significantly due to geography and cost of labor considerations.

## Description

Amazon Ads is seeking a Senior Programmatic Solutions Consultant to join our team supporting Amazon DSP customers.

Amazon Ads helps brands create experiences that delight customers and deliver meaningful results. With 300+ million worldwide active customer accounts, and first-party insights based on shopping, streaming and browsing signals, brands can craft relevant campaigns that enhance customer experiences. Our solutions on Amazon.com, services like Twitch, IMDb TV, Alexa, Amazon Music, and partnerships with third-party publishers and exchanges make Amazon Ads the ultimate amplifier for brands to reach the right audiences in the right places, both on and off Amazon.

Our programmatic advertising platform, the Amazon Demand Side Platform (DSP), is becoming increasingly popular with major advertisers and agencies worldwide. We believe we understand e-commerce advertising better than anybody else and want to turn it into a science of its own that all users can leverage for their programmatic advertising.

As a Senior Programmatic Solutions Consultant (Sr. PSC), you will manage the end-to-end experience of our enterprise customer, known as programmatic trading desks. You will drive success by developing customer expertise in our programmatic advertising DSP. The Senior Programmatic Solutions Consultant has experience in advertising technology and the programmatic advertising domain, and is leveraging this expertise to help our customers meet and exceed their business objectives. In this customer-facing role, you will work closely with programmatic traders at agencies/advertisers, as well as Amazon Ads internal sales, product, and support teams to address customer needs.

A typical Sr. PSC engagement with our customers could include onboarding new traders, delivering trainings on new product features, assisting a customer with a beta feature, consulting in business strategy and planning discussions, providing oversight in execution of campaign strategy, developing campaign optimization recommendations and monitoring their impact, conducting deep dives to determine root causes of issues and informing customers of the best course of action.

You will advocate for customer in internal forums, provide troubleshooting support and triage when needed, and simplify and propagate customer feedback to inform product and services design. Sr. PSCs operate as trusted advisors to customers every day, and ensure customers gradually develop into a proficient users of our DSP, who see Amazon DSP as their preferred means to their goals.

You will be passionate about understanding customer objectives, and address them using our book of services and engagement best practices, to drive adoption of Amazon technologies. Your ownership, curiosity, and domain knowledge will allow you to comprehensively understand the details of our offerings and be able to speak to these to our customers with passion, authority, empathy, and clarity.

Key job responsibilities

Owning the relationship with programmatic trading desk managers, engaging with multiple customer organizational levels to understand business objectives.

Providing services such as onboarding, trade desk support plans, feature training, continuous product usage consultation, and industry best practices

Analyzing and interpreting data to identify improvement areas, root causes, and formulate enablement and adoption recommendations

Driving the evolution of Amazon DSP by assisting customers with product beta participation, capturing customer feedback, and collaborating closely with cross-functional Amazon teams (Product Management, Engineering, Analytics, and Specialists).

Defining and improving processes and tools for the Programmatic Solutions Consultant team to better serve customers.

Integrating adtech and agency-side solutions by partnering with complex, cross-functional teams to deliver programmatic strategies and implementations with limited guidance

About the team

Here at Amazon Ads, we embrace our differences. We are committed to furthering our culture of inclusion. We have 13 employee-led affinity groups, reaching 40,000 employees in over 190 chapters globally.

Amazon’s culture of inclusion is reinforced within our 14 Leadership Principles, which remind team members to seek diverse perspectives, learn and be curious, and earn trust.

Our team puts a high value on work-life balance. We believe striking the right balance between your personal and professional life is critical to life-long happiness and fulfilment.

## Basic Qualifications

\- 6+ years of digital advertising and client facing roles with a focus on data analysis experience

\- Experience in a client facing consultative role working with large, complex enterprise customers

\- Experience in digital advertising and client facing roles with a focus on data analysis

\- Experience with Doubleclick (XSM, DFP), AdJuster or Salesforce

\- Experience managing executive customer relationships and key business stakeholders

## Preferred Qualifications

\- Experience creating processes and improving tools with measurable impact on advertisers

Teneo is the global CEO advisory firm. We partner with our clients globally to do great things for a better future.

**Description**

We’re looking for a high-performing Marketing Senior Manager to drive content strategy across our global marketing programs. This role will develop and execute high-impact thought leadership and content programs and connect them to key audiences across channels (i.e. media, digital, events) and formats.

This role is a critical part of the Marketing team and is ideal for candidates that thrive in dynamic environments, move seamlessly between strategy and execution, and are energized by wearing multiple hats. You’ll partner directly with senior leadership to shape and deliver programs that position our brand and executives credibly and consistently in market.

**Responsibilities**

Marketing Strategy:

- Support strategic planning and delivery of global marketing priorities, in alignment with overall company strategy and objectives

Content Leadership

- Lead development of annual flagship content initiatives, define distribution strategy, and optimize across channels
- Own end-to-end content workflow for content initiatives, including evaluating and prioritizing thought leadership opportunities from across the business
- Identify emerging industry trends and themes we should be speaking to
- Partner with subject matter experts to shape opportunistic ideas into market-ready assets
- Develop and elevate evergreen content initiatives – internal communications, podcast, executive positioning, event programming
- Oversee production and publishing across channels, and ensure consistency in voice, messaging, and quality standards

Media:

- Partner closely with Media team to proactively build media story angles, align content calendar with media strategy, and amplify executive profiles

Analytics & operations:

- Proactively track performance and translate metrics into insights that optimize strategy and improve outcomes.
- Develop and champion processes and frameworks that improve the efficiency and effectiveness of the team.

Leadership & Innovation

**About Us**

Well-Oiled Operations is dedicated to empowering small business owners by transforming their businesses into valuable assets, all while creating more white space on their calendars. Our mission is to streamline and enhance operational efficiency, allowing entrepreneurs to reclaim their time and focus on growth and innovation.

At Well-Oiled Operations, we understand the unique challenges that small businesses face. We specialize in offering tailored solutions that optimize processes, improve productivity, and drive sustainable success. Our team of experts collaborates closely with clients to identify bottlenecks, implement best practices, and leverage cutting-edge technologies. This results in smoother day-to-day operations and a significant boost in overall performance. We believe that a well-organized business is a profitable one.

**ROLE SUMMARY**

We are hiring a Senior Paid Media Manager to own our in-house performance marketing across paid social and paid search. You will start by leading Meta (Facebook and Instagram) campaigns and, over time, expand into additional platforms including Google, YouTube, TikTok, Pinterest, LinkedIn, Spotify, Amazon, and emerging channels like ChatGPT placements.

This is a hands-on role for an experienced media buyer who is just as strong in strategy and data analysis as they are in campaign setup. You are not just pressing buttons. You are responsible for the outcomes: leads, sales, profitability, and the data story behind them. You think cross-channel, optimize daily, and hold yourself to a standard where every dollar spent can be accounted for.

You will work closely with the Meta, Funnels & AI Performance Coach, our Brand & Creative Director, and our Messaging & Copy Strategist to align offers, creative, and funnels. Collaboration is not optional here. The best campaigns come from people who communicate early, share what they are learning, and build on each other's work.

As a growing company, there will be seasons where this role flexes across departments or picks up work outside the core scope to keep things moving. That is the nature of building something at this stage. The expectation is not that every task fits neatly into a job description, but that you lead with ownership, communicate what you are carrying, and help the team solve for it together.

**KEY RESPONSIBILITIES**

**1\. Campaign Management & Optimization**

- **End-to-End Ownership:** Own campaign management across Meta (Facebook and Instagram) to start, then expand into Google, YouTube, TikTok, Pinterest, LinkedIn, Spotify, Amazon, and other platforms as we grow.

- **Full-Funnel Campaigns:** Plan, build, launch, and optimize campaigns for leads, sales, and profitability, not just clicks. You manage the full funnel from top-of-funnel awareness through conversion and retention.

- **Daily Optimization:** Analyze performance daily and weekly. Translate account data into clear actions to improve CAC, ROAS, LTV, and overall profitability. Optimization is the job, not a weekly check-in.

- **Cross-Channel Thinking:** Look beyond single-channel results. Evaluate cross-channel impact and blended performance so decisions are made based on total business outcomes, not siloed metrics.

- **Budget Management:** Manage ad spend responsibly. Pace budgets, reallocate based on performance, and proactively flag when spend is trending off-target before it becomes a problem.


**2\. Tracking, Data & Reporting**

- **Tracking Setup:** Set up and maintain tracking infrastructure: pixels, tags, UTM parameters, conversion events, and server-side tracking. Clean data is non-negotiable.

- **Attribution:** Understand attribution models and their limitations. Be able to explain what the data says and what it does not say, so leadership can make informed decisions.

- **Reporting:** Provide clear, actionable reports to leadership on a weekly and monthly cadence. Reports include what is working, what is not, and what you are doing about it. No vanity metrics.

- **Dashboard Management:** Build and maintain dashboards that give leadership and cross-functional teams visibility into campaign performance without having to ask for updates.


**3\. Testing & Strategy**

- **Testing Roadmap:** Develop and run structured testing roadmaps covering creative, audiences, bidding strategies, landing pages, and offers. Document every test and its learnings.

- **Creative Collaboration:** Partner with the Brand & Creative Director and design team to brief, test, and iterate on ad creative. Bring data-backed creative insights to the table, not just requests for more assets.

- **Funnel Alignment:** Collaborate with the Meta, Funnels & AI Performance Coach to ensure landing pages, offers, and post-click experiences are aligned with campaign strategy. The ad is only as good as the funnel behind it.

- **Messaging Collaboration:** Work with the Messaging & Copy Strategist to test and refine ad copy, hooks, and angles. Share performance data so copy decisions are informed by results, not guesswork.

- **Platform Expansion:** As you prove mastery on Meta, proactively research and recommend expansion into new platforms. Come with a plan, not just a suggestion.


**4\. Collaboration & Communication**

- **Cross-Functional Partnership:** Work closely with marketing, sales, coaching, and creative teams. Share what you are seeing in the data, ask for context, and align on offers, messaging, and timing.

- **Proactive Updates:** Keep leadership informed on campaign performance, risks, and opportunities. Do not wait to be asked. Surface insights early and often.

- **Platform Intelligence:** Stay on top of platform changes, algorithm updates, best practices, and new advertising opportunities. Share relevant updates with the team so everyone benefits.

- **AI & Efficiency:** Leverage AI tools to streamline reporting, automate repetitive tasks, and surface insights faster. Track hours saved and share workflows that work with the team.


**5\. Coachability & Continuous Learning**

- **Training Program:** Actively participate in our advertising training program. Use our curriculum, coaching calls, and resources to sharpen your skills and expand into new platforms.

- **Feedback Implementation:** Receive coaching and feedback with an open mind. Implement it quickly. We hire smart people and then invest in making them better. Your willingness to learn is just as important as what you already know.

- **Ownership of Growth:** Take responsibility for your own development. Ask questions, seek out new certifications, stay current on platform changes, and continuously improve your craft.

- **Knowledge Sharing:** When you learn something that works, share it. When you make a mistake, share that too. We build each other up by being open about what we are learning.


**KEY PERFORMANCE INDICATORS**

Performance is measured monthly and reviewed quarterly. Primary KPIs are the business outcomes this role is accountable for. Secondary KPIs track the habits, processes, and collaboration that drive those outcomes.

**PRIMARY KPIS**

- **ROAS / Profitability**

 - Hit or exceed target ROAS and blended profitability goals set each quarter. Specific targets vary by campaign and channel.
- **Cost Per Acquisition (CAC)**

 - Maintain or reduce CAC quarter over quarter while scaling spend. Targets set per funnel and offer.
- **Lead Volume & Quality**

 - Hit monthly lead volume targets with qualified leads that convert downstream, not just form fills.
- **Campaign On-Time Launch**

 - 100% of planned campaigns launch on schedule with complete tracking, creative, and copy in place.
- **Budget Pacing**

 - Monthly spend lands within 5% of target. No end-of-month scrambles or unplanned overages.

**SECONDARY KPIS**

- **Testing Velocity**

 - At least 2 structured tests per platform per month (creative, audience, bidding, or landing page). All tests documented with results and learnings.
- **Reporting Cadence**

 - Weekly performance reports delivered to leadership on time, every week. Monthly deep-dive reports delivered by the 5th of each month.
- **Tracking Accuracy**

 - Zero major tracking gaps or broken events. Pixel health and conversion tracking audited monthly.
- **Cross-Functional Collaboration**

 - Creative briefs submitted with data-backed rationale. Copy and funnel feedback shared at least biweekly with relevant team members.
- **Platform Expansion Readiness**

 - Quarterly recommendation on new platform opportunities with projected budget, audience, and testing plan.
- **AI Efficiency**

 - At least 2 AI-powered workflows adopted per quarter that measurably save time or improve output quality.

**EXPERIENCE & QUALIFICATIONS**

- **Experience:** 5 to 7+ years of hands-on experience running paid media campaigns, including Meta Ads Manager plus at least one additional major platform (Google, YouTube, TikTok, LinkedIn, etc.).

- **Budget Management:** Proven track record managing meaningful ad budgets and consistently hitting performance targets (ROAS, CAC, lead volume, profitability).

- **Analytical Strength:** Strong analytical skills and fluency with ad platform dashboards, Google Analytics or GA4, and reporting tools. You read data, spot patterns, and make fast, high-quality optimization decisions.

- **Full-Funnel Expertise:** Experience building and managing full-funnel campaigns from top-of-funnel awareness through conversion and retention, not just boosting posts or basic traffic campaigns.

- **Tracking & Attribution:** Hands-on experience setting up pixels, conversion APIs, UTM structures, and server-side tracking. You understand attribution models and their blind spots.

- **Testing Discipline:** Experience running structured A/B and multivariate tests on creative, audiences, landing pages, and bidding strategies with documented learnings.

- **Cross-Functional Collaboration:** Experience working with creative, copy, and marketing teams to brief assets, align messaging, and improve campaign performance through collaboration.

- **In-House Preferred:** In-house experience strongly preferred. We are not looking for someone who managed from a distance at an agency. We want someone who has been embedded in the business, owned the outcomes, and felt the results.

- **Bonus:** Experience in online education, coaching, info-product, or creator businesses. Familiarity with VSLs, webinar funnels, challenge launches, and high-ticket offer structures.


**WHO THRIVES IN THIS ROLE**

- **Owner Mentality:** You think like an owner, not a button-pusher. You care about the business outcomes, not just your ad account.

- **Optimization Obsessed:** You understand that campaign setup is step one. Optimization is the job. You are in the data daily, not weekly.

- **Cross-Channel Thinker:** You care about how each channel contributes to the overall business, not just your silo. You ask "What is the blended result?" before declaring a win.

- **Coachable:** You are confident in your skills and humble enough to learn new ones. When someone gives you feedback, your first instinct is to try it, not defend your way.

- **Communicator:** You share what you are seeing, ask for what you need, and keep people in the loop without being asked. Collaboration is how you work, not something you do when forced.

- **Builder:** You are excited by the idea of building something from the ground up, not inheriting a machine someone else built. You want to shape the playbook, not just follow one.


**WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE**

Within your first 90 days, you:

- **Own Meta:** Have taken full ownership

DOE Media is a premier, data-driven firm specializing in global digital advertising and retention marketing. Our expertise lies in crafting sophisticated solutions that drive substantial growth for partners, ranging from dynamic startups to Fortune 500 brands. With a versatile portfolio, we engage with both B2B and B2C partners, including eCommerce, franchises, technology, apps, sports, events, financial services, and retailers. DOE Media has generated over $2+ Billion in trackable, profitable online revenues. Marketing is moving fast, and so are we. As the marketing world evolves, we’re evolving with it, embedding AI into how we think, create, and optimize. It’s how we stay ahead of the curve, not just on it

Founded by seasoned entrepreneurs with a history of successfully building, scaling, and exiting direct-to-consumer (D2C) businesses, DOE Media is committed to delivering EBITDA-driven growth for our valued partners.

Embracing a culture built on the pillars of Data Over Ego, Partners as the Hero, Cutting Edge Knowledge – We are the Experts, Professionalism, and Work Ethic define who we are. If your values resonate with ours, we’re eager to meet you!

**Where We Are Going**

Having propelled ourselves forward with an impressive $550+ million in digital ad spend and a remarkable $2+ Billion in generated revenue over the past three years, our journey has been nothing short of extraordinary. Yet, we’re not hitting the brakes; rather, we’re gearing up for an ambitious future! Our sights are set on expanding our in-house team and client base sevenfold within the next five years.

As we continue to evolve, this is your golden opportunity to be an integral part of our forward-thinking journey. Join us and be a catalyst for the exciting chapters that lie ahead!

**What We’re Looling For**

We are looking to hire an experienced Senior Google PPC Specialist to join our Paid Search team. The ultimate objective is to grow and scale the client’s paid media accounts by driving equal or lower costs per customer acquisition, while increasing paid media spend through Google. We need you to demonstrate proficiency in Advertising and Marketing principles to identify the most cost-effective solutions. Our clients will look to you for guidance, ideation, and to bring their goals to reality.

**What You’ll Do**

- Develop and implement comprehensive paid strategies to increase brand visibility and recognition, and drive new user acquisition and leads via paid Google campaigns
- Dive deep into client brands to best understand key value proposition, products, and aesthetic
- Utilize Google Ads Manager, Analytics, and Supermetrics to develop insights and action items intended to increase client revenue MoM
- Compile regular reports and dashboards to quantify results and communicate insights to the client
- Prepare advertising timelines for client onboarding, launch, and ongoing account maintenance
- Create and test copy for Google campaigns to generate engagement from targeted audience
- Keep up-to-date with target audience preferences to proactively suggest new campaigns
- Conduct thorough competitive research of products, markets, services, and current competitor strategies
- Surface new digital technologies developments, trends, techniques, and tools to leadership
- Communicate updates, progress, and challenges with clients and internal stakeholders

**What You’ll Bring**

- 5+ years of eCommerce Google PPC Search and Shopping experience
- Ability to interpret data to proactively identify and solve problems
- Expertise in Google Analytics in an eCommerce setting
- Communication skills – the kind where your message gets through to any audience
- Creative problem-solving capabilities: think outside the box, inside the box, and all around the box
- Ability to prioritize the priorities at the moment, know what you need to do and when you need to do it
- Collaborate effectively in a team environment
- Integrity, optimism, and respect regardless of the situation – non-negotiable
- BONUS: Additional platform experience such as Facebook, Pinterest, and Snapchat

**What You’ll Find Here**

- Benefits that matter like time off without limits, healthcare coverage, and more
- Learning from the best. Collectively, we have years of expertise in ecommerce, digital advertising, and brand optimization
- A challenge. We’re here to push you. Our goal is to give you experience and connections you won’t forget
- Access to our leadership, industry experts, and peers that care about you and your development

# Senior Program Manager - Digital Marketing, Enterprise I.T.

Location:Fountain Valley, CACompany:Silicon Beach Solutions

## Description:

Job DescriptionJob Description

**Please review the details below before applying to ensure this opportunity aligns with what you’re seeking.**

**This is a Consulting/Contractor role structured as a Corp-to-Corp engagement, not a W-2 position. As such, contractors are responsible for their own state and federal taxes, deductions, and benefits. The role is billed and paid on an hourly basis, based on a standard 8-hour workday (week, year).**

**There is potential for this engagement to develop into a longer-term contract based on overall fit and performance. Contracts are usually 1-year terms with the likely possibility of renewal on an annual basis for extended terms based on overall fit and performance. Annual renewals will likely include performance-based rate increases.**

**The position follows regular Pacific Time business hours, with occasional additional hours as needed.**

**We kindly ask that staffing agencies refrain from submitting candidates. We cannot accommodate visa transfers.**

**On-site Requirement:** Applicants should be based in Orange County, Southern California, as this is an on-site role.

We are seeking a **Senior Program Manager** to run multiple Enterprise Interactive Marketing Web Projects using Agile, Waterfall, and hybrid Agile/Waterfall SDLCs to join our team. We are looking for someone who has experience, brings positive energy, is a quick and critical thinker, and knows how to use the various enterprise tools to schedule and facilitate meetings, take effective MoMs, etc. Experience and Energy matter! You will coordinate activities for Developers, BSAs, QA, Client Resources, and Third Party Resources to ensure that Project workstreams are on track, identify any potential risks and mitigations, operate the JIRA and Confluence tools for each workstream, create weekly status slides for Business Leadership, and update statuses in various project management tools (Jira, Confluence, SmartSheet), among other Program Management duties. This is a hands-on role working that requires collaboration with Digital Agencies and other Service Providers in order to ensure that delivery of projects stays on track and impediments are anticipated and mitigated ahead of time.

**Responsibilities:**

- Drive execution and delivery of multiple high-profile technical, product, or software development projects from start to finish.
- Manage intra- and inter-team dependencies, highlight project blockers and risks,s and work with cross-functional teams to resolve them.
- Track and manage dependencies across multiple projects; lead escalation processes to make issues visible to stakeholders and leadership; drive resolution of dependency issues through the process.
- Partner with project teams to identify interdependencies, conflicts, and risks associated with delivery. Identify and manage all project dependencies and the critical path. Complete dedication to the PMO and all the activities within; creating a weekly agenda, publishing a weekly status, meeting coordination, meeting recaps, RAID Log activities, and assessing various projects or task-related artifacts.
- Collaborate with Product Managers on project objectives, provide clear communications to teams and stakeholders on milestones, deliverables, and success criteria.
- Develop trusted partnerships with stakeholders by collaborating and delivering on common goals.
- Ensure that projects and priorities support the partner's strategic plans and that each project is managed to ensure on-time implementation and flawless execution.
- Facilitate backlog grooming and story deconstruction.
- Manage demand by working closely with all constituents to prioritize programs and projects based on business needs, resource capacity, risk exposure, and interdependencies.
- Develop delivery plans for complex projects and programs.
- Manage project schedules, identify possible issues, and clearly communicate them to project stakeholders.
- Maintain a clear overview of project timelines (Agile/Kanban boards, Gantt charts, spreadsheets, etc.) and progress using project and task management tools (primarily in Jira and Confluence).
- Provide timely updates on the status of projects to a cross-functional audience in multiple formats.
- Leverage Agile and SDLC methodologies to lead teams on a daily basis to the successful delivery of software development projects in accordance with the delivery framework and established best practices. Remove impediments; track blockers and report slippages with workable mitigation plans.
- Manage daily scrums, sprint planning, sprint retrospectives, and sprint demos.
- Frequently communicate program and roadmap status and schedule updates. Create and maintain project documentation (primarily in Confluence) that is the single source of truth about a project to keep teams aligned and informed.
- Work with senior leadership, stakeholders, partners, and delivery teams to track and maintain a program-level view of initiatives.
- Work closely with vendors, product managers, and engineering teams to get high-quality products and features through various internal and external software project release lifecycles.
- Lead overall project stage gate review processes by conducting readiness assessments to identify gaps in readiness throughout the project life cycle.
- Identify project risks; analyze and communicate prioritized mitigation plans to stakeholders. Ensure proper execution of risk, issue, and communication management.
- Own overall project communications, escalate risks, and manage the issue resolution process. Continuously monitor projects/programs' status and impact on customer relations.
- Escalate project risks and constraints to the senior management team in a timely manner.
- Work with the Product Owners, Project Managers, and Specialists to interview, review, analyze, develop, and craft business requirements, user stories, wireframes, and storyboards for website redesign projects.
- Participate in User Acceptance Testing and business quality assurance.

​ **Qualifications:**

- **3-5 years as a Project or Program Manager working in the Digital world or IT.**
- **Bachelor's degree in Business, Marketing, or IT.**
- **Experience in Automotive Digital, Digital Retail, or large-scale eCommerce Programs is a huge plus.**
- Atlassian JIRA and Confluence
- Agile SDLC and associated ceremonies
- Status Slides for Leadership using PowerPoint
- **Project Management Tools such as JIRA/Confluence and SmartSheets**
- Strong Microsoft Office skills (Excel, PPT, Teams, etc)
- Strong troubleshooting and critical thinking skills
- Ability to prioritize and multitask
- Deadline and detail-oriented
- Strong communication skills
- Proactive communicator
- Ability to work in a fast-paced and high-pressure environment while maintaining composure
- Ability to schedule meetings in Teams, etc
- Using a VPN where needed
- PMP certification is a plus
- Working on projects that included full-stack development of large-scale Web and Mobile Applications
- Working on projects that include Cloud, especially AWS-related implementations
- Working on projects that included DevOps and CI/CD
- Working on projects that include the implementation/use of AI platforms
- No babysitting required. Can come in quickly and add impact and support
- Must be accountable, professional, respectful, and punctual

# Ecommerce Growth Marketing Senior Paid Media Specialist

Location:USCompany:Apex Brands

## Description:

We are a DTC Ecommerce Growth Consulting & Marketing Company focused on helping service businesses attract, engage, and convert their ideal audience.

Our Mission: to help DTC ecommerce companies grow holistically

Our Vision: We imagine a world where service businesses never have to worry about meeting revenue goals, attracting consistent quality customers, retaining customers, or maintaining and growing their overall online presence.

Our Values:

\- Treat others the way we want to be treated

\- Pay close attention to detail

\- Don't neglect the small things, they matter

\- Think critically and be a problem solver, not a problem creator

\- Confidence and determination to achieve our vision.

Who We Are Looking For:

We are looking for an ecommerce Paid Media Specialist who has experience managing large ad budgets across Meta and Google primarily. (Ideally over 1 million dollars USD per month). Additionally, if you experience using MTAs such as NorthBeam, incrementality testing tools, and MMM tools for data validation that is a major plus.

The candidate selected for this role would come in and manage the Meta, Google, and/or TikTok ad accounts for US based ecommerce brands. We have a lot of high-profile ecommerce clients that we work with and we are looking for a seasoned Paid Media Specialist who can produce high quality results for our clients.

The right candidate will be task-oriented, analytical, and willing to keep the team and ad accounts on pace to make sure we are meeting or exceeding client expectations. A self-starter who can see problems and go to work fixing them and not be just an order taker. The ideal candidate will have a strong background in managing Facebook Ads and Google Ads for US based ecommerce brands.

Must have a portfolio of work that demonstrates the results that you have been able to provide and the KPIs you have hit. Must also demonstrate your skills with creative testing through media buying on Facebook, Instagram, and TikTok ads.

Responsibilities

- Manage the Meta, Google, and/or TikTok ad accounts of US based ecommerce brands
- Run ad campaigns across Meta, Google, and TikTok
- Monitor ROAS, ad budgets, revenue, and core KPIs to optimize campaigns and achieve the desired results for our clients
- Run profitable creative testing campaigns and identify trends to be able to communicate with the client what is working and what we should be creating more of
- Create performance marketing reports for the accounts that you are managing to accurately display the analytics, results, and next steps
- Strategize on ways to improve the overall marketing strategy for our brands to increase effectiveness
- Maintain awareness of current industry and technology standards, social media, competitive landscape, and market trends

Qualifications & Experience

- Bachelor's degree in Marketing or related field OR 3-4 years of experience OR alternative education experience (mentors or courses)
- Prior experience working for an ecommerce brand or advertising agency is preferred
- Must be proficient in Facebook & Google Ads management for ecommerce brands
- Must be proficient in scaling ad budgets
- Strong communication, conceptual thinking, and a hunger to always provide great results for our clients
- Autonomous worker with an analytical mind
- Portfolio of work, results, or case studies
- You should be comfortable using some internal communication tools such as Monday.com, Google Drive, Zoom, and Slack for team meetings and to support other team members with any technical request. Experience with Monday.com or Asana is not required but please let us know if you have used it before or not.
- You should also be confident enough to push back on the leadership team and express your opinion if you think the ship is heading off course. We encourage that.

Base Salary Range:

- $5,000 - $10,000 USD per month

Just as a disclaimer, please don't use AI or ChatGPT during the screening or interview process. We use a screening tool that can detect AI in your answers and during interviews. Using AI will result in your application being immediately disqualified.
