# Senior Manager, Growth Marketing & Search

Location:Collierville, TNCompany:The Juice Plus+ Company

## Description:

Juice Plus+ is seeking a commercially minded, data-driven Senior Manager, Growth Marketing & Search to lead two of our most important growth engines: Paid Media (USA) and Organic Search (Global).

This role sits at the intersection of performance marketing, search visibility, content strategy, and growth marketing. The successful candidate will be responsible for driving revenue growth through paid media, increasing organic visibility across traditional and AI-powered search platforms, and translating channel performance into actionable recommendations that improve business outcomes.

Working closely with agency partners, Social, CRM, PR, Analytics, IT, and Commercial teams, this role will act as the strategic owner of Growth Marketing and Search performance. The role will identify opportunities, guide priorities, and ensure channel investments align with broader business objectives.

As search continues to evolve, this position will help shape how Juice Plus+ appears across Google Search, AI Overviews, ChatGPT, Gemini, Perplexity, and emerging answer engines, ensuring the brand remains visible and competitive in the future of search.

The role supports both customer acquisition and Partner growth objectives, with a primary focus on revenue generation, ecommerce growth, lead generation, and brand visibility across the digital ecosystem.

**What You Will Own**

**Paid Media – USA**

- Own the paid media strategy and performance across Meta, Google, YouTube, TikTok, Microsoft Ads, and Connected TV.
- Drive customer acquisition, revenue growth, and lead generation through full-funnel media strategies aligned to annual business objectives.
- Manage agency partners responsible for campaign execution, optimization, testing, and performance reporting.
- Drive performance against key KPIs including Revenue, ROAS, CVR, CAC, AOV, Lead Generation, and Customer Acquisition targets.
- Develop testing roadmaps focused on audiences, messaging, offers, creative themes, landing page experiences, and campaign structure.
- Translate channel insights into actionable recommendations for Social, CRM, Creative, and Commercial teams, ensuring marketing investments and content priorities are informed by performance data.

- Support customer acquisition, Partner lead generation, and recruitment initiatives through targeted campaigns aligned to key business priorities and seasonal moments throughout the year.
- Partner with Sales, Field Development, and Commercial teams to support lead generation and recruitment objectives while maintaining a primary focus on customer growth and revenue generation.
- Support platform integrations and operational initiatives that improve campaign performance, audience targeting, reporting visibility, and marketing effectiveness.
- Identify emerging growth opportunities across creator commerce, affiliate marketing, referral programs, TikTok Shop, and new acquisition channels.
- Maintain a strong understanding of the evolving digital advertising landscape, proactively identifying opportunities to improve efficiency, scale, and competitive advantage.

- Monitor competitor activity, search trends, and emerging AI search developments.
- Translate keyword, search, and audience intelligence into content opportunities that support acquisition, education, and authority-building objectives.

# Senior Paid Media Strategist

Location:Chicago, ILCompany:Bottle Rocket Media

## Description:

**Role:** Senior Paid Media Strategist

**Location:** Chicago, IL

**About Us**

Bottle Rocket Media is an award-winning video production and marketing agency in Chicago specializing in video production, motion graphics, SEO, and video marketing. We partner with brands and businesses, ranging from startups to large corporations to creative agencies, to make an impact through video and comprehensive SEO & marketing initiatives.

**About You**

We love the world of video and marketing and hope you do, too. There will always be on-the-job training on our processes and standards, but we cannot teach someone to be positive, kind, self-motivated, hard-working, enthusiastic, fun, and organized. If you have these personality traits, read on.

**How to Apply**

If you meet the requirements below and are excited about working with the BRM team, we would love to hear from you! Please apply by emailing your resume to jobs@bottlerocketmedia.net.

**What Success Looks Like for a Senior Paid Media Strategist at Bottle Rocket Media**

As a Senior Paid Media Strategist, you'll play a key role in developing and executing paid media strategies across multiple accounts and platforms while managing ad spend and performance-driven campaigns. You'll work closely with performance data, balance strategic thinking with day-to-day execution, and take real ownership of the results you drive for clients. Success in this role means managing BRM's and our clients' ad spend with precision, insight, and accountability across every major platform.

**Strategy & Execution**

- Campaign strategy reflects a clear understanding of the client's business goals, audience, and customer journey.
- Campaigns are structured intentionally for each platform, with clear objectives, targeting, and performance metrics.
- Multiple accounts are managed with consistency, accuracy, and strong attention to detail.

**Budget & Performance Management**

- Monthly ad spend is managed responsibly through proactive pacing, budget allocation, and bidding decisions.
- Campaign performance is evaluated against KPIs such as ROAS, CPA, CTR, and conversion rate.
- Performance reporting connects campaign results to broader client business goals.

**Creative Collaboration**

- Collaboration with the Marketing team to develop concepts, copy, and assets that support campaign goals.
- Creative feedback is grounded in performance data and audience behavior.
- Ad creative is tailored to each platform's native format and placement.

**Insights & Optimization**

- Data is used to understand how campaigns are performing and why.
- Recommendations are specific, actionable, and tied to clear performance opportunities.
- Optimization decisions can be explained and supported with data.

**Organization & Collaboration**

- Communication with clients and internal teams is clear, timely, and solution-oriented.
- Manage priorities, deadlines, and follow-ups proactively across multiple accounts.
- Accounts are kept organized and audit-ready, with consistent naming conventions, tracking, and settings.

**Duties and Responsibilities**

- Plan, launch, and manage paid advertising campaigns across Facebook, Instagram, LinkedIn, X, Reddit, TikTok, Google, YouTube, and other platforms as needed.
- Oversee a combined monthly ad budget of $200K+ and manage multiple client accounts, focusing on pacing and allocation to support campaign goals.
- Develop paid media plans based on each client's business objectives, target audience, and funnel stage.
- Build and maintain campaign structures, including audience targeting, bidding strategies, budgets, placements, and other platform settings.
- Collaborate with the Marketing team to brief and develop ad creative, copy, and supporting assets.
- Lead A/B and multivariate testing across creative, audiences, messaging, and other campaign variables.
- Monitor campaign performance and make timely adjustments based on results, budget needs, and campaign priorities.
- Track and analyze KPIs, including ROAS, CPA, CTR, conversion rate, and reach, and use the findings to evaluate campaign effectiveness.
- Create comprehensive, visually engaging performance reports that clearly communicate results, key takeaways, and recommendations to clients and internal stakeholders.
- Use ad platforms, Google Analytics, and other measurement tools to maintain accurate campaign tracking and attribution.
- Coordinate with account managers and producers to align paid media campaigns with broader client marketing and content initiatives.
- Stay informed on platform updates, advertising policies, emerging channels, and industry trends that may affect campaign strategy.
- Identify opportunities to expand or improve paid media efforts through new platforms, tactics, audiences, or testing strategies.

**Qualifications and Skills**

- 5+ years of hands-on experience managing paid social and search campaigns, ideally in an agency setting.
- Proven experience managing significant monthly ad budgets across multiple clients or brands.
- Hands-on expertise in Facebook/Instagram Ads Manager, Google Ads, LinkedIn Campaign Manager, and TikTok Ads Manager, with familiarity with X and Reddit ad platforms.
- Proven track record of using performance data to make strategic campaign adjustments and inform creative recommendations.
- Sharp analytical skills with the ability to translate data into actionable insights.
- Strong communication skills and ability to present performance results confidently to clients and internal teams.
- Self-motivated, detail-oriented, and accountable, with ownership of outcomes.
- Open to learning, staying current on platform changes, and continuously improving strategy.

**Salary Range:**

$70,000 - $80,000, based on experience

# Senior Paid Media Strategist (Chicago)

Location:Schiller Park, ILCompany:Bottle Rocket Media

## Description:

**Role:** Senior Paid Media Strategist

**Location:** Chicago, IL

**About Us**

Bottle Rocket Media is an award-winning video production and marketing agency in Chicago specializing in video production, motion graphics, SEO, and video marketing. We partner with brands and businesses, ranging from startups to large corporations to creative agencies, to make an impact through video and comprehensive SEO & marketing initiatives.

**About You**

We love the world of video and marketing and hope you do, too. There will always be on-the-job training on our processes and standards, but we cannot teach someone to be positive, kind, self-motivated, hard-working, enthusiastic, fun, and organized. If you have these personality traits, read on.

**How to Apply**

If you meet the requirements below and are excited about working with the BRM team, we would love to hear from you! Please apply by emailing your resume to jobs@bottlerocketmedia.net.

**What Success Looks Like for a Senior Paid Media Strategist at Bottle Rocket Media**

As a Senior Paid Media Strategist, you'll play a key role in developing and executing paid media strategies across multiple accounts and platforms while managing ad spend and performance-driven campaigns. You'll work closely with performance data, balance strategic thinking with day-to-day execution, and take real ownership of the results you drive for clients. Success in this role means managing BRM's and our clients' ad spend with precision, insight, and accountability across every major platform.

**Strategy & Execution**

- Campaign strategy reflects a clear understanding of the client's business goals, audience, and customer journey.
- Campaigns are structured intentionally for each platform, with clear objectives, targeting, and performance metrics.
- Multiple accounts are managed with consistency, accuracy, and strong attention to detail.

**Budget & Performance Management**

- Monthly ad spend is managed responsibly through proactive pacing, budget allocation, and bidding decisions.
- Campaign performance is evaluated against KPIs such as ROAS, CPA, CTR, and conversion rate.
- Performance reporting connects campaign results to broader client business goals.

**Creative Collaboration**

- Collaboration with the Marketing team to develop concepts, copy, and assets that support campaign goals.
- Creative feedback is grounded in performance data and audience behavior.
- Ad creative is tailored to each platform's native format and placement.

**Insights & Optimization**

- Data is used to understand how campaigns are performing and why.
- Recommendations are specific, actionable, and tied to clear performance opportunities.
- Optimization decisions can be explained and supported with data.

**Organization & Collaboration**

- Communication with clients and internal teams is clear, timely, and solution-oriented.
- Manage priorities, deadlines, and follow-ups proactively across multiple accounts.
- Accounts are kept organized and audit-ready, with consistent naming conventions, tracking, and settings.

**Duties and Responsibilities**

- Plan, launch, and manage paid advertising campaigns across Facebook, Instagram, LinkedIn, X, Reddit, TikTok, Google, YouTube, and other platforms as needed.
- Oversee a combined monthly ad budget of $200K+ and manage multiple client accounts, focusing on pacing and allocation to support campaign goals.
- Develop paid media plans based on each client's business objectives, target audience, and funnel stage.
- Build and maintain campaign structures, including audience targeting, bidding strategies, budgets, placements, and other platform settings.
- Collaborate with the Marketing team to brief and develop ad creative, copy, and supporting assets.
- Lead A/B and multivariate testing across creative, audiences, messaging, and other campaign variables.
- Monitor campaign performance and make timely adjustments based on results, budget needs, and campaign priorities.
- Track and analyze KPIs, including ROAS, CPA, CTR, conversion rate, and reach, and use the findings to evaluate campaign effectiveness.
- Create comprehensive, visually engaging performance reports that clearly communicate results, key takeaways, and recommendations to clients and internal stakeholders.
- Use ad platforms, Google Analytics, and other measurement tools to maintain accurate campaign tracking and attribution.
- Coordinate with account managers and producers to align paid media campaigns with broader client marketing and content initiatives.
- Stay informed on platform updates, advertising policies, emerging channels, and industry trends that may affect campaign strategy.
- Identify opportunities to expand or improve paid media efforts through new platforms, tactics, audiences, or testing strategies.

**Qualifications and Skills**

- 5+ years of hands-on experience managing paid social and search campaigns, ideally in an agency setting.
- Proven experience managing significant monthly ad budgets across multiple clients or brands.
- Hands-on expertise in Facebook/Instagram Ads Manager, Google Ads, LinkedIn Campaign Manager, and TikTok Ads Manager, with familiarity with X and Reddit ad platforms.
- Proven track record of using performance data to make strategic campaign adjustments and inform creative recommendations.
- Sharp analytical skills with the ability to translate data into actionable insights.
- Strong communication skills and ability to present performance results confidently to clients and internal teams.
- Self-motivated, detail-oriented, and accountable, with ownership of outcomes.
- Open to learning, staying current on platform changes, and continuously improving strategy.

**Salary Range:**

$70,000 - $80,000, based on experience

# Senior Amazon PPC Specialist / PPC Strategist

Location:USCompany:Flaunt Brands

## Description:

Amazon PPC Specialist / Senior PPC Analyst

**Job Type:** Full-Time

**Experience:** 3+ Years in Amazon PPC

Job Overview

We are seeking an experienced, analytical, and results-driven **Amazon PPC Specialist** to manage and optimize advertising campaigns across multiple Amazon brands.

The ideal candidate has extensive hands-on experience with Amazon Sponsored Products, Sponsored Brands, and Sponsored Display campaigns, along with a strong understanding of Amazon's advertising algorithm, keyword ranking, and organic sales growth.

This position requires someone who can independently develop advertising strategies, analyze performance data, identify growth opportunities, and consistently improve advertising profitability.

Key Responsibilities

- **Campaign Management:** Build, manage, and optimize Amazon PPC campaigns across multiple brands and product categories.
- **Keyword Research:** Conduct advanced keyword research, competitor analysis, and search term analysis to identify high-converting opportunities.
- **Bid Optimization:** Continuously adjust bids, placements, and budgets to maximize sales while maintaining profitable ACOS and TACOS.
- **Campaign Strategy:** Develop and execute sophisticated PPC strategies, including keyword isolation, single-keyword campaigns, product targeting, and ranking-focused campaigns.
- **Performance Analysis:** Monitor and analyze key advertising metrics, including ACOS, TACOS, ROAS, CPC, CTR, CVR, and organic ranking.
- **Scaling:** Identify opportunities to scale profitable campaigns, increase market share, and launch new products successfully.
- **Reporting:** Prepare performance reports with actionable insights and recommendations.
- **Troubleshooting:** Identify underperforming campaigns, wasted ad spend, and opportunities to improve conversion rates.
- **Automation:** Utilize PPC management software, bulk operations, and advanced reporting tools to improve efficiency and campaign performance.
- **Strategic Planning:** Develop advertising strategies that balance immediate profitability with long-term organic growth.

Qualifications

- Minimum 3 years of hands-on experience managing Amazon PPC campaigns.
- Proven track record of successfully managing substantial Amazon advertising budgets.
- Advanced knowledge of Amazon Sponsored Products, Sponsored Brands, and Sponsored Display.
- Strong understanding of Amazon keyword ranking, campaign structure, and advertising attribution.
- Experience with Amazon PPC tools such as Helium 10, Pacvue, Quartile, Perpetua, or similar platforms.
- Advanced Excel or Google Sheets skills, including pivot tables and data analysis.
- Ability to independently analyze large datasets and translate findings into actionable strategies.
- Strong analytical thinking, attention to detail, and problem-solving skills.
- Experience managing multiple brands or a large portfolio of ASINs.
- Familiarity with Amazon Marketing Stream, Amazon Marketing Cloud, or Amazon DSP is a plus.

What We're Looking For

We are looking for someone who goes beyond routine bid adjustments and understands the strategy behind successful Amazon advertising.

The ideal candidate knows how to identify opportunities competitors are missing, structure campaigns intelligently, allocate advertising budgets effectively, and drive sustainable growth.

**We want a strategic thinker who understands both the technical and commercial sides of Amazon PPC.**

# Senior Digital Marketing Manager

$75k - $85k

FOCUS Mission Foundation

[Golden, CO](https://jooble.org/jobs/Golden%2C-CO)

[Apply](https://jooble.org/away/-3372008793731832977?p=1&pos=0&rgn=8309&pageType=7&jobAge=4156&jdpSource=101&jdpid=4246100283932837876&crId=US_0US_0)

**Location:** Golden, CO

**Hours** : Full Time

**Position Mission**

The Senior Digital Marketing Manager (Content & Growth) leads the execution and optimization of FOCUS’ digital presence across key channels, including social media, blog, email, and web.

This role translates established brand strategy, content pillars, and campaign priorities into cohesive, high-performing digital experiences. By partnering closely with the Brand & Creative team, this individual ensures that creative vision is consistently and effectively executed across channels while optimizing for audience engagement and growth.

Grounded in the mission of FOCUS, this role leverages digital platforms as a means of evangelization—helping reach, engage, and invite others into a deeper relationship with Jesus Christ.

Additionally, this role identifies and removes barriers to execution across the digital team streamlining workflows, improving processes, and enabling teams to operate with greater clarity and efficiency. This role also plays a key leadership function within the digital team by mentoring channel owners and helping develop platform-specific strategies that effectively reach distinct audiences.

**Position Responsibilities**

**Content Execution and Calendar Management**

• Build and manage content calendars across social media, blog, email, and web

channels based on established content pillars and campaign priorities.

• Ensure consistent cadence, alignment with organizational priorities, and timely

execution of content across platforms.

• Incorporate key moments such as campaigns and the liturgical calendar into content

planning.

**Editorial Translation and Channel Strategy**

• Translate high-level messaging and content pillars into clear, platform-specific

content plans.

• Adapt messaging to fit the nuances of each channel and audience.

• Ensure clarity, cohesion, and consistency in how FOCUS’ message is communicated

across digital platforms.

**Creative Partnership**

• Partner with the Brand & Creative team to bring creative vision to life across digital

channels.

• Provide input on how creative concepts should be adapted for different platforms

and user experiences (email, web, social, blog).

• Ensure all digital content is both on-brand and optimized for engagement and

performance.

**Team Leadership & Social Media Partnership**

• Partner closely with the Social Media Manager to ensure digital content strategy is

effectively executed across social channels.

• Provide mentorship and strategic guidance to the social media team, helping elevate

channel-specific strategies and execution.

• Support the development of differentiated approaches across platforms (e.g.,

Instagram, LinkedIn, etc.) to better reach and engage target audiences.

• Foster clarity, alignment, and consistency in how content is planned and executed across the team.

**Cultivate Divine Intimacy:**

- Personal prayer and/or daily Mass, when possible
- Avail yourself of other spiritual opportunities
- Be a consistent witness for Jesus Christ, and maintain a courteous, Christ-like attitude in dealing with people outside of FOCUS
- Live out the moral life in Christ
- A practicing Catholic or Christian in good standing with the Catholic Church. There is no other background, qualification, or experience that can substitute for this requirement

**Qualifications**

- 3+ years of experience in digital marketing, content marketing, or social media
- Experience managing organic social media channels and/or blog content
- Strong understanding of platform-specific best practices (Instagram, LinkedIn, etc.)
- Experience with analytics tools and performance reporting
- Ability to translate high-level messaging into effective digital content
- Strong written communication and storytelling skills
- Experience with A/B testing and performance optimization

**Desired Attributes**

- Strong executor who can translate strategy into action
- Analytical mindset with a focus on continuous improvement
- Highly organized with the ability to manage multiple priorities
- Collaborative and able to work cross-functionally
- Passion for the mission of FOCUS and digital evangelization

**Compensation & Benefits**

For this role, we anticipate paying **$75,000 - $85,000/year** . This range is an estimate. The actual amount may be higher or lower than the provided range and will be adjusted based on various factors including qualifications, experience, abilities, geographic location, and duties.

As a FOCUS Mission Foundation staff member, you and your family will have access to several benefits that are designed to help care for the whole person and make your career with us rewarding. You will receive:

- Medical, Vision and Dental insurance
- Ability to contribute to a Health Savings Account
- Employer-provided life insurance
- Long-term disability insurance
- Option to purchase additional life insurance for yourself, your spouse and your child(ren)
- 403(b) retirement plan with a discretionary employer-match for eligible staff
- Option to purchase LifeLock Identity Protection
- Integrity-based Paid Time Off
- Paid parental leave
- We observe many paid holidays recognized by fellow Americans and also some of the feast days of Holy Mother Church. In addition, we recognize the Sacred Christmas Respite by closing the office from December 24-January 1 each year.

Eligibility for benefits depends on the type of position you hold (full-time, part-time or temporary), and your tenure with FOCUS Mission Foundation. Specific benefits may change at our discretion.

# Senior Organic Growth Marketing Manager

Nurp

[Miami, FL](https://jooble.org/jobs/Miami%2C-FL)

[Apply](https://jooble.org/away/7277054997312228531?p=1&pos=0&rgn=9649&pageType=7&jobAge=303&jdpSource=101&jdpid=-6591357881412510243&crId=US_0US_0)

**This role remains open for applications as we actively identify top talent to join our bench for future openings. While the position isn’t active at this moment, we’re building a pipeline of exceptional candidates for upcoming opportunities.**

POSITION SUMMARY

As the Organic Social Media Manager at Nurp, you will be responsible for owning, growing, and operating our organic presence across every major platform, including Instagram, TikTok, YouTube, LinkedIn, X, Reddit, and Facebook. This role is ideal for a hands-on, metrics-driven marketer who will build distinct, platform-native content engines, craft compelling multi-format content, manage active communities, and directly connect organic engagement to pipeline revenue.

The Organic Social Media Manager serves as a key brand and growth driver for the Company and is expected to manage Nurp’s digital footprint with creativity, discipline, and strong attention to compliance. You will develop monthly strategies, establish operational workflows with our internal content team, maintain daily community management, build analytics dashboards, and ensure every piece of content meets strict financial marketing standards.

This is a fully remote, full-time opportunity best suited for an adaptable, highly accountable individual contributor who thrives in a fast-paced fintech environment and prefers executing work directly over high-level delegation.

### ABOUT THE COMPANY

Nurp builds smart trading algorithms that help people trade more effectively across multiple markets, including FX, Commodities and Crypto. We’re reshaping the way people invest by using powerful, data-driven technology instead of outdated methods. At Nurp, we’re focused on growth, both in the markets we serve and in the people we hire. This is a place for driven, results-oriented individuals who want to take ownership, learn quickly, and make an impact. You’ll work alongside a talented team, contribute to meaningful projects, and help shape the future of algorithmic trading. We move fast and wear many hats, creating constant opportunities for personal and professional growth.

### RESPONSIBILITIES

- **Content Strategy & Platform Pillars:** Develop distinct, platform-native content pillars and maintain an individualized voice for each channel rather than cross-posting identical content. Map monthly calendars at least two weeks ahead to product updates, team interviews, client testimonials, webinars, and market events.

- **Publishing Cadence:** Maintain a consistent baseline publishing rhythm of 4 to 5 short-form videos per week across Reels, TikTok, and Shorts, 3 to 4 LinkedIn and X posts per week, and daily stories or community touchpoints, continuously adjusting frequency based on performance data.

- **Content Creation & Repurposing:** Establish a formal request cadence and operational workflow with our in-house content team to obtain raw materials. Slice webinars, YouTube videos, and customer interviews into platform-native clips while writing direct, credible copy in Nurp's voice.

- **Community Management:** Oversee daily community interactions by responding to comments and DMs across all platforms within 24 hours, while proactively engaging with relevant creators in the trading and investing space.

- **Analytics & Performance Tracking:** Build and maintain a weekly performance dashboard tracking reach, engagement rate, follower growth, video completion, link clicks, qualified leads, booked calls, and sales attributed to organic social.

- **UTM & Attribution Management:** Own UTM creation, management, and auditing across all published links using standard naming conventions and shared tracking tools to protect attribution integrity. Untagged or inconsistently tagged links break reporting and are non-negotiable.

- **Prescriptive Reporting:** Deliver a monthly report to marketing leadership explicitly detailing: what worked, what underperformed and why, what will change next month, and data-backed recommendations for upcoming content experiments.

- **Issue Escalation:** Rapidly flag and escalate negative sentiment, misinformation, or impersonation/scam accounts following established risk protocols.

- **Compliance Adherence:** Apply financial-marketing compliance guardrails to every post, ensuring zero promises of guaranteed returns, accurate performance language, and proper risk disclosures.

- **30-Day Deliverables:** Complete a full audit of all seven channels with a written "Keep, Kill, and Start" assessment; establish the baseline performance dashboard; publish the first forward-looking monthly content calendar; evaluate and organize existing content libraries; work with IT to evaluate current UTM usage and deliver formal recommendations for improvement; and establish a structured request cadence with the content team.

- **60-Day Deliverables:** Achieve a full publishing cadence live on every platform, meet the 24-hour community response SLA consistently, deliver the first monthly analysis report (including at least three data-backed experiments), and meet all expected monthly performance KPIs (reach, follower growth, leads, and booked calls).


### KEY COMPETENCIES

- Ability to develop distinct content strategies, platform-native voices, and non-repetitive content pillars tailored to individual social platforms.

- Strong end-to-end video production and editing skills for short-form video formats (Reels, TikTok, Shorts).

- Deep understanding of platform-native algorithms, trends, and audience behavior across Instagram, TikTok, YouTube, LinkedIn, X, Reddit, and Facebook.

- Exceptional copywriting skills with the ability to write direct, human, and non-hype-driven copy.

- Strong organizational and system-building skills to manage forward-looking content calendars, asset pipelines, and content team request workflows.

- Analytical fluency with the ability to interpret full-funnel metrics (from top-of-funnel reach down to booked calls and closed revenue) and maintain strict UTM attribution.

- High integrity and attention to detail when operating under compliance-heavy and regulated industry frameworks.


### EDUCATION AND EXPERIENCE

- Minimum of 3–5 years of hands-on organic social media management experience for a brand (in-house or agency) with documented examples of channel growth and measurable contribution to leads, pipeline, or revenue.

- Demonstrated track record of editing, scripting, and producing high-performing short-form video assets independently.

- Working fluently with platform analytics platforms (Meta Insights, TikTok Analytics, YouTube Studio, LinkedIn Analytics) to measure full-funnel pipeline, including lead opt-ins and booked calls.

- Preferred experience in finance, investing, fintech, trading, or another heavily regulated industry.

- Preferred experience growing YouTube channels across both long-form and Shorts formats.

- Proficiency with social media and marketing tools such as HubSpot, Claude, UTM managers, and social listening/scheduling software.


### BENEFITS

- 100% Remote work.

- Target annual bonus - 5% to 10

- Health insurance.

- Dental insurance.

- Vision Insurance.

- Voluntary Life Insurance.

- Paid Time Off.

- Opportunities for professional development and training.

- Access to our product and services at significant discounts and, in some instances, free


### COMMITMENT TO DIVERSITY

Nurp is an equal opportunity employer committed to fostering an inclusive and diverse workforce. We encourage applicants from all backgrounds to apply, regardless of race, color, religion, age, national origin, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, or disability.

## **Company Overview**

**Imagine Everything. Build the Future with Hexion.**

**At Hexion, we push boundaries, rethink possibilities, and create real impact.** We activate science to deliver progress—developing breakthrough solutions that strengthen industries, protect communities, and drive a more sustainable future.

## **Position Overview**

Location: Hybrid, Columbus OH

We are hiring a **Senior Content Strategist** to lead content strategy and executive communication for Hexion.

This role is responsible for strengthening our growth and brand marketing ensuring the website, content ecosystem, brand messaging, exec comms, and sales content support long-term commercial objectives.

You will work cross-functionally with business leaders, sales teams, and external partners to create high-impact content and maintain a high-performing, insight-driven digital presence.

This is a hands-on, high-visibility role suited for someone who combines strong editorial judgment with digital performance expertise.

This role will require up to 10% travel with 4 trips expected per year. The travel could be global in nature.

## **Key Responsibilities**

1. **Enterprise Content Strategy:** Develop and manage a structured, content roadmap aligned with brand positioning and long-term growth priorities. Ensure company-wide messaging consistency while enabling vertical-specific differentiation.
2. **Growth-Oriented Content Creation:** Partner with business units and sales to translate commercial priorities into compelling content across formats, including website pages, event materials, sales decks, brochures, and case studies.
3. **Brand Focused Thought Leadership Development:** Build unique and engaging authority-building assets that strengthen Hexion’s credibility and support downstream demand generation efforts.
4. **Website Ownership & Governance:** Own the content on Hexion’s website and overall performance in collaboration with the wider marketing team. Manage publishing workflows, UX coordination, content audits, and ongoing optimization.
5. **SEO, AEO, & Organic Performance:** Lead SEO/ AEO strategy across the website, including keyword planning, on-page optimization, and content structuring to improve organic visibility and search rankings.
6. **Web Analytics & Insight Generation:** Monitor website performance using GA4 and related tools. Develop dashboards and insights that inform content strategy, user experience improvements, and digital investment decisions.
7. **Brand Stewardship & Digital Governance:** Uphold Hexion’s overall brand standards across digital channels. Establish content guidelines, tone-of-voice frameworks, and digital governance processes.
8. **Exec Communication:** Support our CEO with external communication, including creating personalized social content, though leadership content, and event and conference content.

## **Minimum Qualifications**

- 8-12 years of experience in B2B content marketing, digital strategy, or website management
- Strong experience developing and leading enterprise-level content strategies across multiple business units
- Experience with building a personal brand for C-suite leaders and supporting exec comms.
- Experience with using AI tool and building custom agents like Tone of Voice Agent, to accelerate work and automate manual tasks.
- Proven ability to create high-impact case studies and thought leadership content
- Experience managing and optimizing B2B websites at scale
- Hands-on experience with:
 - CMS platforms (Webflow, WordPress, Sitecore, or similar)
 - GA4 and website analytics tools
 - SEO/ AEO tools and best practices
- Strong understanding of how content supports demand generation (without necessarily owning campaigns)
- Proven ability to translate technical or industrial subject matter into clear, compelling messaging
- Experience coordinating cross-functional stakeholders and managing external vendors
- Strong editorial judgment and brand stewardship capability
- Analytical mindset with comfort interpreting digital performance data

### **Who We Are** Cobalt was founded on the belief of a fundamental human aspiration: the desire to live better and safer. It all started in 2013, when our founders realized that pentesting can be better. Today our diverse, fully remote team is committed to helping organizations of all sizes with seamless, effective and collaborative Offensive Security Testing that empower organizations to OPERATE FEARLESSLY and INNOVATE SECURELY. Our customers can start a pentest in as little as 24 hours and integrate with advanced development cycles thanks to the powerful combination of our SaaS platform and an exclusive community of testers known as the Cobalt Core. Accepting just 5% of applicants, the Cobalt Core boasts over 400 closely vetted and highly skilled testers who jointly conduct thousands of tests each year and are at the forefront of identifying and helping remediate risk across a dynamically changing attack surface. Cobalt is an equal-opportunity employer, and we strive to build a diverse and inclusive workforce. At Cobalt, we aspire to engage with diverse individuals, communities, and organizations to continue to nurture our unique, rich, diverse culture. Join our team, and be your true self to do your best work.

### **Description**

Cobalt is looking for a **Senior Growth Marketing Manager** to join our marketing team. This isn’t a traditional demand gen role. We are building a sophisticated Growth Marketing framework that is focused on automation and orchestration to identify accounts with the highest propensity to buy, and nurture them into turning purchase ready.

In this role, you will develop and execute integrated marketing playbooks and measure the efficacy of the programs on regular cadences. With the goal of generating and accelerating pipeline across North America and EMEA regions, you will leverage your experience to build systems that are scaleable, repeatable and sustainable.

With tight alignment with Sales and Revenue Operations teams, you will utilize Salesforce, UserGems, HubSpot to identify intent and track buyer movement, in support of both new business and expansion pipeline. You are accountable, fearless in taking ownership, and ready to move beyond “lead gen” to innovate programs across the entire customer journey.

### **What You’ll Do**

- **Full-Lifecycle Account Progression:** Develop and execute integrated marketing plans aligned to company growth objectives, focusing on both new logo acquisition and expansion within existing customer accounts.
- **Multi-Touch Program Engagement** : Drive multi-channel initiatives (such as email, webinars, social, direct mail and digital advertising) to guide target prospects through every phase of the buyer journey.
- **Automation & AI Agents:** Design and oversee automated agents to streamline routine workflows, accelerate program delivery, and ensure swift, confident execution.
- **Intent & Movement Orchestration:** Use UserGems intent signals and tracking to trigger automated playbooks that reach and engage buying committees and follow previous champions to new target accounts.
- **Customer Marketing & Advocacy:** Develop programs to nurture existing customers, leveraging their success stories to drive whitespace expansion and cross-sell.
- **Content Strategy & Execution:** Co-own the content calendar alongside the content team, designing multi-format programs to engage key contacts and activate target accounts.
- **Sales & Success Enablement:** Act as the primary marketing contact for sales and BDR teams, leading weekly syncs to align, equip, and empower sellers on activation plans and performance expectations.

$149k - $196.04k

Full-time

Traditional Medicinals

[Rohnert Park, CA](https://jooble.org/jobs/Rohnert-Park%2C-CA)

**SUMMARY**

The Revenue Growth Manager is a member of the Sales Strategy & Planning (SS&P) team and will build and drive Traditional Medicinals' revenue growth management (RGM) capability across retail pricing, price-pack architecture, promo Experience building analytical tools, models, and reporting from the ground up, in an environment without an established RGM functional effectiveness, and trade investment strategy. This role builds the analytical foundation, guardrails, and decision framework that determine how TM prices its portfolio and invests its trade dollars across channels and leads the pricing and trade investment stage of the Strategic Business Planning process. The person in this role will partner with sales, finance, marketing, and supply chain to convert data into profitable growth decisions and will build RGM capability across the commercial organization as TM expands into new channels and new product forms.

**ESSENTIAL FUNCTIONS**

1. **Pricing & Price-Pack Architecture:**
 - Own pricing strategy and execution across sales channels, key customers, and product formats
 - Build and maintain price elasticity models, and size proposed price moves before they go to market
 - Develop price-pack architecture recommendations that support entry into new channels and new product forms
 - Monitor price realization versus plan and identify sources of margin leakage across the gross-to-net waterfall
2. **Trade Investment Strategy:**
 - Develop multi-year trade rate strategy and recommend annual trade rates by customer, country, and form
 - Establish written pricing and trade investment guardrails, including a pre-commitment review and sign-off process for promotional events
 - Measure post-event promotional ROI on a standardized basis and reallocate investment toward higher-return mechanics
 - Conduct exception review of promotional spend and partner with sales leadership to correct events performing outside of guardrails
3. **Strategic Business Planning:**
 - Lead the pricing and trade investment strategy stage of the annual Strategic Business Planning (SBP) process for top retailers
 - Provide pricing, promotional, and trade rate inputs to the business review, growth target setting, and customer plan build stages of SBP
 - Partner with category management to translate category and shopper insight into price and promotion recommendations for customer plans
 - Contribute to SBP governance and performance tracking, including post-event ROI review at the established planning cadence
4. **Analytics & Decision Support:**
 - Build and own the trade spend scorecard and RGM reporting suite, in partnership with the category management team
 - Establish and maintain a reconciled gross-to-net waterfall in partnership with Finance and Accounting
 - Decompose growth into price, volume, and mix, and translate that decomposition into actionable sales plays
 - Conduct scenario and what-if analysis on pricing, promotional, and assortment changes to inform annual planning and the Integrated Business Planning process
5. **Capability Building & Cross-Functional Partnership:**
 - Serve as the RGM point of contact and trusted advisor across sales, finance, marketing, supply chain, and category management
 - Lead organizational adoption of Revenue Growth Management principles and influence changes in commercial decision-making practices.
 - Build RGM tools, playbooks, and documentation that scale with the business, and train the commercial organization in their use
 - Partner with the Sales Operations Manager to ensure pricing and trade strategy are accurately reflected in the trade promotion management system and the annual operating plan, including through the migration to a new trade promotion platform
 - Provide RGM inputs to the Integrated Business Planning process, including pricing and promotional assumptions that affect the demand plan
6. **Other:**
 - Foster a culture of profitable growth, analytical rigor, and continuous improvement across the commercial organization

**SUPERVISORY/BUDGET**

- This position does not have direct reports
- This person will own the pricing and trade investment strategy and guardrails governing an annual trade budget, which is executed and managed by the Sales Operations Manager

**REQUIREMENTS**

**Experience/Education:**

- Bachelor's degree in business, finance, economics, statistics, or a related field
- 10+ years of experience in revenue growth management, pricing, trade strategy, category management, or commercial finance - preferably in the CPG industry
- Demonstrated working knowledge of at least three RGM levers: strategic pricing, price-pack architecture, trade investment optimization, and mix management
- Experience with trade promotion management systems & syndicated data (SPINS preferred); experience supporting a TPM implementation or migration preferred
- Experience building analytical tools, models, and reporting from the ground up, in an environment without an established RGM function preferred
- Experience working with or presenting to retail customers preferred
- Advanced Microsoft Office skills required, especially Excel & PowerPoint

**Knowledge/Abilities/Skills:**

- Strong business & financial acumen, including pricing, trade spend, velocity, incrementality, mix, and profitability
- Proven ability to influence cross-functional teams and senior stakeholders without direct authority
- Ability to build and interpret price elasticity models, including portfolio-level effects and cannibalization
- Ability to reconcile data across multiple systems and sources into a single, defensible view of the business
- Disciplined prioritization; identifies the few initiatives that will deliver measurable results and declines the rest
- Excellent communication and presentation skills, with a proven ability to translate complex analysis into clear recommendations for commercial and executive audiences
- Ability to teach and enable others, building a shared commercial vocabulary across sales, finance, and marketing
- Comfortably establishing new processes, guardrails, and governance where none exist today
- Critical thinker with a bias for action and a results-oriented approach
- Collaborative team player who proactively fosters strong partnerships
- Comfortable navigating ambiguity and adapting to complex & evolving business needs

**Technical Skills:**

- Advanced Microsoft Excel, including financial modeling and scenario analysis
- Syndicated and retailer data platforms (SPINS, Nielsen, Circana, retailer POS portals)
- Power BI or comparable BI tools, including dashboard development
- Trade promotion management (TPM) systems
- ERP and financial planning systems (D365 and Adaptive preferred)

**Travel Requirements** :

- As a sales position, there will be occasional overnight travel required (up to 10%)

**Office Hours/Location:**

- This position is based in Rohnert Park, CA. Office hours are Monday through Friday, 8:30 – 5:00 pm. This is a hybrid role offering the flexibility to occasionally work remotely. Expected in-offices days are Tuesday and Thursday. Subject to change.
- Remote candidates will not be considered for this role.

**Physical/Mental Requirements:**

- The physical demands described here are representative of those that must be met by an employee to successfully perform the essential functions of this job. Reasonable accommodation may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.
- While performing the duties of this job, the employee is regularly required to sit and talk or hear. The employee is occasionally required to stand; walk; reach with hands and arms; and stoop, kneel, crouch or crawl. The employee must occasionally lift and/or move up to 10 pounds. Specific vision abilities required by this job include close vision.

- Lead daily campaign management, campaign reporting, monitoring, and optimizations for client accounts
- Lead daily maintenance,  tracking, and monitoring of campaign budgets and KPIs, maximizing growth potential on accounts.

Excel & AI Proficiency

# Senior Marketing Manager

$130k - $150k

Full-time

Guidant Power

[Chicago, IL](https://jooble.org/jobs/Chicago%2C-IL)

[Apply](https://jooble.org/away/-7018335024190133968?p=1&pos=0&rgn=11886&pageType=7&jobAge=454&jdpSource=101&jdpid=8003513914292739804&crId=US_0US_0)

Build the growth engine. Own the function. Accelerate your career.

**LOCATION** Remote (Chicago Pref’d) **REPORTS TO** CEO

**BASE SALARY** $130,000 to $150,000 **TARGET BONUS** 20%

**The Opportunity**

Guidant Power is looking for a high-potential B2B marketer ready to take the next major step in their career. This is a hands-on leadership opportunity to build and own the marketing function of a rapidly growing, private equity backed services company.

We are looking for a builder. You will own Guidant's lead generation engine, HubSpot, campaigns, marketing metrics, budget, agencies, and the process for creating qualified pipeline one and two quarters ahead of sales requirements. You will report directly to the CEO and work closely with sales and operating leadership.

Why This Role Is Different

• You will own the marketing function, not one channel or a narrow piece of the funnel.

• You will work directly with the CEO and senior leadership on growth priorities, investment decisions, and performance.

• You will participate in Shore Capital's marketing cohort, sharing best practices and learning alongside marketers across a top 1% private equity firm’s portfolio.

• You will gain direct experience with organic growth, M&A integration, cross-sell programs, and the operating discipline of a rapidly scaling services platform.

• You will be judged on measurable business results, and success can lead to broader responsibility as Guidant grows.

**What You Will Own**

• Build the lead flow model required to support bookings goals, including how many leads and qualified opportunities Guidant needs and how far in advance they must be created.

• Create and manage integrated campaigns across email, paid media, social, events, conferences and trade shows, webinars, outbound BDR programs, SEO, and targeted accounts.

• Own the marketing calendar, campaign priorities, annual marketing plan, and budget.

• Oversee HubSpot implementation and operate HubSpot as Guidant's top-of-funnel platform for campaigns, lead scoring, qualification, workflows, attribution, and reporting.

• Build dashboards that show pipeline generated by source, funnel conversion, cost per qualified opportunity, campaign ROI, and pipeline coverage one and two quarters forward.

• Use qualitative market research with customers, prospects, salespeople, and technical experts to improve positioning, content, offers, and campaigns.

• Manage agencies, contractors, paid media partners, content resources, data vendors, and other outside resources for quality, cost, timing, and results.

• Support Guidant's M&A strategy by helping integrate acquired companies into Guidant's marketing systems, processes, brand, and cross-sell programs.

**Who We Are Looking For**

You do not need to have already led an entire marketing function. This role may be particularly attractive to someone who is ready for broader ownership and accountability.

• 5 or more years of progressive B2B marketing experience, with a record of increasing responsibility and strong business results.

• Demonstrated success personally building and executing demand generation programs that create qualified opportunities and pipeline.

• Strong hands-on experience with HubSpot or a comparable marketing automation platform, with enough technical understanding to build workflows, reporting, and campaigns and manage outside implementation resources.

• A strong marketing foundation across segmentation, positioning, customer acquisition, qualitative market research, content, SEO, paid media, social, email, events, and account-based marketing.

• Comfort working with data, funnel metrics, attribution, campaign measurement, budgets, and reporting that connects marketing investment to pipeline and revenue.

• The judgment and communication skills to work effectively with sales, operations, technical experts, outside partners, and senior leadership.

The Person Who Will Thrive Here

• Ambitious builder: energized by creating something that does not yet exist and eager to earn broader responsibility.

• Strategic and hands on: able to move from market insight and investment decisions to campaign briefs, HubSpot workflows, dashboards, and vendor management.

• Commercially minded: treats marketing as a revenue-generating function and focuses on qualified opportunities, sales productivity, pipeline, and ROI.

• Customer curious: listens well, asks strong questions, identifies patterns, and turns insight into better campaigns and positioning.

• Self-directed and accountable: moves with urgency, follows through, and is comfortable being measured on results.

**What Success Looks Like**

• Guidant can reliably answer how many leads and qualified opportunities are needed each quarter and how much future pipeline marketing created this month.

• Leadership knows which channels and campaigns create the best opportunities, what a qualified opportunity costs, and which investments should be increased, improved, or stopped.

• Marketing consistently creates qualified opportunities early enough to improve pipeline coverage one and two quarters forward and make the sales team more productive.

• HubSpot, attribution, funnel reporting, and marketing-to-NetSuite handoffs operate reliably and provide a measurable path from first engagement through booked business.

**Compensation**

The expected base salary range is $130,000 to $150,000, depending on experience and qualifications, plus a 20% target annual performance bonus. The role is designed for a high-potential marketer ready to earn broader leadership responsibility through measurable results.

**About Guidant Power**

Guidant Power creates safer, more productive workplaces by helping companies improve electrical safety, reliability, and employee capability. We serve as a trusted guide through arc flash studies, infrared thermography, electrical engineering, healthcare specific electrical safety services, and training. Four values guide how we work: safety, trust, teamwork, and continuous improvement. We hire people who share them and who get results by making the team around them better. Our customers include well-known global and national companies such as Nestlé, Land O'Lakes, Bridgestone, Abbott, and Chord Energy. Guidant is growing organically and through acquisitions to build a national electrical safety and reliability services platform.

Full-time

InstaLILY

**We will review only applications submitted to our hiring portal:**

New York Office

**About InstaLILY**

InstaLILY builds AI teammates for the physical-goods economy — industrial distribution, healthcare, supply chain, manufacturing, and automotive. Our model is simple: one company brain, many teammates. We build company-specific AI-powered brains called InstaBrains. Built on small, specialized language models (SLMs), they codify the customer’s knowledge and decisions, like their parts, jobs, and pricing. On top of it, InstaWorkers act as AI teammates inside the tools customers already use, completing the sales, service, and operations work that drives the business.

Backed by **Insight Partners** ($25M Series A) and supported by the **Google** , **NVIDIA** , and **Microsoft** ecosystems, we are one of the fastest-growing AI startups in the country. Our team has already driven over $200M in incremental revenue for customers to date. InstaLILY’s architecture has been featured in Google DeepMind’s case study showcase.

We’re driven by three core principles—Customers, Culture, and Code—what we call The Three C’s.

## **The Role**

You’ll be our lead writer, producing the content that drives InstaLILY’s voice in the world. Our newsletters, long-form thought leadership, case studies, and social posts all flow through you. You’ll work closely with our CEO Amit and other leaders who will give direct, detailed feedback. You’re proactive: proposing topics and angles, shaping what we should be writing about, not just executing on assignments. You lead with your own voice and judgment, using AI in service of your thinking rather than as a replacement for it. You’ll also have direct influence on what content InstaLILY produces and how.

Experimentation is core to the role. You form sharp hypotheses about what will move the needle — content angles, headlines, channel mix, distribution timing — and ship tests fast. You measure what worked, double down on the wins, and kill what didn’t. Writing is the craft; impact is the goal.

## **What You’ll Do**

- **Lead writing:** Write InstaLILY's most visible content — LinkedIn and X posts that amplify Amit's, Sumo's, and InstaLILY's POVs; long-form thought leadership on AI agents, enterprise AI, and the future of the industries we serve (industrial distribution, construction, manufacturing, food & beverage, automotive, field services, and related sectors); newsletters that land with different audiences (PE investors and operators); case studies and customer stories (like our SRS Distribution piece); press releases; landing page copy; product marketing copy; and sales enablement materials.
- **CEO and leadership collaboration:** Work directly with our CEO Amit and cross-functional leaders to translate strategic POV into writing. Iterate fast and apply feedback with judgment.
- **Research:** Research the AI landscape and the industries we serve. Translate complex technical and industry concepts for different audiences (operators, executives, investors).
- **Events content:** Contribute content for our events program: hosted summits, fireside chats, mixers, Tech Week programming, Women in AI gatherings, and conference and expo presence.
- **Run experiments:** Form clear hypotheses about what will drive traffic, engagement, or pipeline. Ship tests fast, watch the data, double down on what works, kill what doesn’t.
- **Own distribution:** Drive reach through SEO, social amplification, syndication, and lifecycle email.
- **Big-picture thinking:** Think strategically about the writing — how each piece builds InstaLILY’s presence over time, what’s working across channels, what we should be saying more (or less) of.

## **What You’ll Need**

- **4–6 years of writing experience:** As a copywriter, content marketer, journalist, or technical writer.
- **Demonstrated writing track record:** Across formats — long-form, social, editorial. Show us what you’ve shipped.
- **Strong writing chops:** Clean, direct, specific, no filler.
- **Current on the AI and tech landscape:** You live where the discourse happens — Substack, X, serious tech journalism, AI research commentary, founder discourse online. You track what’s shipping across AI labs, startups, and the broader ecosystem.
- **AI-native with judgment:** Daily user of Claude, ChatGPT, Cursor, or similar tools, with personal workflows for research, drafting, and editing. You know when AI sharpens the work and when it produces slop. The voice in the final piece is yours, not the model’s.
- **Deeply curious:** You ask good questions, pull on threads until you understand things fully, read and research widely beyond the immediate task, and treat learning as part of the craft.
- **Technical fluency:** Comfortable writing about AI agents, enterprise systems, and operational industries (distribution, manufacturing, field services) with accuracy.
- **Experimental mindset:** You think in hypotheses, not deliverables. You form clear bets (“if we test X, Y will move”), ship them quickly, and learn from results — wins or misses. You’re comfortable being wrong; the test is the point.
- **Numerical fluency:** Comfortable with content analytics (Google Analytics, LinkedIn, HubSpot). Bonus for experience with A/B testing or experimentation platforms.
- **Takes feedback well:** You absorb direct, iterative notes from leaders across the team and apply the learning to future work, not just the immediate piece.
- **Start date:** Targeting a May start date.
- **Writing samples:** Please include 2–3 with your application (links preferred). Bonus for samples that cover AI, enterprise tech, or technical subjects written for non-technical audiences.

## **What You’ll Get**

- **Real traction:** The product works and customers are live — this isn’t a bet on an unproven thesis.
- **AI-native:** In how we build, how we work, and what we sell.
- **Visibility:** Your writing sits at the center of how the world sees InstaLILY — what you do here will be visible quickly.
- **Stage:** Early enough to shape how the company scales.
- **Culture:** Offices in New York, San Francisco, and London — sharp, low-ego team that keeps raising the bar.
- **Growth:** The learning curve is steep.

## **Compensation and Benefits**

- **Salary Range:** $80,000 – $100,000 per year, commensurate with experience
- **Equity:** Generous stock options awards and refreshers for top performers
- **Benefits:** Medical, Dental, Vision, 401K, Well-being stipend, In-office lunch reimbursement, PTO and 10 US Federal Holidays, and more!

# Senior Creative Strategist - Paid Social, Ecomm/DTC Brands Only (100% Remote)

$5,000 - $7,500 per month

Temporary

Brick.

[Remote](https://jooble.org/jobs/Remote)

- Remote job

[Apply](https://jooble.org/away/-8099292663765238077?p=1&pos=0&rgn=55157&pageType=7&jobAge=598&jdpSource=102&jdpid=5017560882392717975&crId=US_0US_0)

**The Opportunity**

Most "creative strategists" at agencies are really project managers. They pass client requests to an editor, chase revisions, and never see whether the ad made money.

That's not this seat.

Brick Social runs paid media and creative for e-commerce and DTC brands only: SHITI Coolers, Spotlight Oral Care, Atlas Headrest, Minnie Wellness, The Nokbox. One niche, total depth. Every account is a Shopify-economy brand, so the ads you brief on Monday show up as revenue (or don't) by Friday. You'll know which.

You won't be a lone creative fighting for attention, either. You sit inside a pod with a dedicated Meta buyer, a Google buyer, a video editor, and a graphic designer (static editor), all working off the same numbers. Your buyer reads fatigue signals daily and asks for replacements the same day. Your video editor and designer turn your briefs into finished video and static ads. Our pods ship roughly 136 new assets a month, about 7 fresh ads a day, and you decide what they are.

And you're paid like an owner, not a seat. Our pod profit share pays out 20% of pod profit above the margin floor, quarterly. When your creative wins, your paycheck grows. The math is shared openly, and it's the same math I use.

**Your Mission (Should You Choose to Accept It):** Own creative strategy for every e-commerce account in your pod. Decide what we test, write the briefs, direct the video editor, graphic designer and UGC creators, and read the results. Then do it again, faster. Your job is simple to say and hard to do: find the next winning ad before the current one dies, every account, every month.

**The Role - What You'll Own**

**1\. The creative strategy** \- you're the creative lead on up to 8 DTC accounts. For each one you own the angle map, the testing roadmap and the hypotheses: which customer, which problem, which hook, which format. You pull the performance data yourself (Meta Ads Manager, Motion, Triple Whale) and turn it into the next round of briefs. You use AI to go deeper and faster on research: mining reviews, Reddit threads and competitor ads for the customer language that becomes your next hook.

**2\. The brief-to-launch machine** \- you write direct-response scripts, static concepts and briefs your video editor and static designer can execute without a follow-up call. AI is part of how you work: you use it to draft scripts and hook variations, then sharpen the best ones yourself, and to QA-check every brief and finished ad (claims, spelling, sizing, brand rules) before anything goes live. Creative goes into our launch system with fixed Mon/Wed/Fri launch windows and hard cutoffs, so "almost ready" doesn't count.

**3\. The UGC engine** \- you run UGC for every account in your pod: who we cast, what they say, and which clips become ads. You write the creator briefs and scripts, review first cuts, give direction on reshoots, and pick the footage your editor builds from. Our admin handles the paperwork behind it (outreach, contracts, product shipments, payments and usage rights tracking), so your time goes to directing creators, not chasing them.

**4\. The feedback loop** \- a 15-minute daily pulse with your pod and a weekly creative-media sync with your buyer to decide what's winning, what's fatiguing and what's next. You also lead creative on client calls, pitching new concepts with the reasoning behind them and the result you expect.

**5\. The testing framework** \- your first big project: build Brick's creative testing framework for the DTC brands in your pod. That means how we choose tests, how we read them, and when we call a winner. It becomes part of how the whole agency works.

**Your Targets (Radical Transparency)**

You'll see your scorecard on Day 1. Reviews here have zero surprises.

**KPIs:**

- Hit Rate (share of new ads that become winners): 20%+
- Revision Rate: under 10%
- On-Time Delivery: 95%+
- Error Rate: under 0.05%

You don't need to be perfect on day one. But you do need to be the kind of person who sees these numbers, gets excited, and immediately starts thinking about how to beat them.

**Who You Are**

**Deal-Makers:**

- ✅ **Agency-side, multi-account experience** \- you've run creative for 4-8 ecomm brands at once and know the rhythm; this is not a first-agency-job role
- ✅ **Performance creative, not brand creative** \- you've briefed and shipped paid social ads for Meta (TikTok is a bonus) in the last 2 years, and you can name ads you made that scaled, with the spend and results behind them
- ✅ **You read the data yourself** \- hook rate, hold rate, CTR, CPA, ROAS; you know the difference between an ad with a bad hook and an ad with a bad offer, and you don't wait for a buyer to tell you
- ✅ **You write** \- direct-response scripts and hooks are your strongest tool; you can write a 10-second Meta ad that grabs attention from the first frame
- ✅ **You direct creators** \- you've written UGC briefs and gotten usable footage back without three reshoots
- ✅ **You can hold your own in the tools** \- basic editing and design (CapCut, Canva, Figma or Adobe) so you can mock up a concept or fix a frame yourself
- ✅ **AI-first workflow** \- you already use AI tools (ChatGPT, Claude or similar) every day for research, scripting and QA, and you're always pushing to get more out of them; you can show us how AI makes your work faster and better, not just more
- ✅ **US time zone** \- you work US hours, anywhere from Pacific to Eastern, and your briefs land before the Mon/Wed/Fri launch cutoffs without fail

**Deal-Breakers:**

- ❌ You've never been accountable for how your ads performed, only for shipping them
- ❌ Your portfolio is brand, social or organic content with no paid results attached
- ❌ You need a buyer or account manager to tell you what to make next
- ❌ You've only ever worked on 1-2 in-house brands and have never carried an agency workload

**You're Perfect If You:**

- Have a swipe file of hundreds of ads and can tell us why each one works
- Have built your own AI prompts or workflows for research, scripts or creative QA, and keep improving them
- Watch a competitor's new ad and can guess its hook rate before you finish it
- Get genuinely annoyed when a winning ad runs for six weeks without a fresh version behind it
- Bonus: you've made creative for Shopify-economy DTC brands and know what a winning ad does to a store's conversion rate

**The Package**

**Compensation:** Base $5,000-$7,500/month USD + quarterly pod profit share (based on experience and location)

**Perks That Matter:**

- 100% remote - always has been, always will be
- A production team in your pod, plus an admin who handles UGC logistics - you'll never be stuck editing your own briefs or chasing creator invoices
- Weekly group training hour w/ Founder + monthly 1:1
- $5K referral bonus when you bring us an A-player

**Our Values**

**1\.** **Extreme Ownership** \- when an ad flops, you say "that's mine" and you've already briefed the fix.

**2\.** **Growth** \- you're better at this job in December than you were in January, every year.

**3\.** **Exceeding Expectations** \- "delivered as briefed" is the floor, not the goal.

**4\. Openness** \- you speak up for what you believe in, including when you think the client's idea won't work.

_Include the number (1, 2, 3, or 4) of the value that resonates most with you in your application._

**The Process**

**1\. Apply** \- takes 10 minutes. Include a portfolio of ads you've made for bonus points.

**2\. Video interview with Tony** (~30 min)

**3\. Skills test** (1 hour, capped) - we give you a real brand and its ad data; you give us 3 concepts and one finished brief.

**4\. Final interview**

**5\. Reference check → offer within 1-2 weeks of your first interview**

# Senior Growth Manager - LATAM \[Remote\]

Full-time

LemFi

[United States](https://jooble.org/jobs/United-States)

- Remote job

[Apply](https://jooble.org/away/1976393834780534109?p=1&pos=0&rgn=0&pageType=7&jobAge=646&jdpSource=101&jdpid=8450784649280531054&crId=US_0US_0)

LemFi (Series B) is building the go-to financial app for the Global South.

Moving to a new country shouldn’t mean starting from zero. That's why our team of 400+ spanning 20+ countries is building a financial ecosystem that helps immigrants stay connected to home, build stability, and create wealth regardless of where they are from or where they live.

What began as fast, affordable remittances is now evolving into a complete platform for multi-currency accounts, payments, credit, and long-term financial growth.

With millions of users across the globe, we process over $1B in monthly transactions to 30+ countries, proving that borders shouldn't limit financial opportunity.

**About the role**

Having established payout operations in Brazil, LemFi is expanding aggressively across Latin America - launching and scaling in Colombia, Guatemala, and Mexico. This is the role that makes that expansion real. As Senior Growth Manager - LATAM, you will own our market expansion strategy end-to-end. Reporting directly to the Head of LATAM, you will work across paid channels, organic strategy, local agency partners, and product teams to drive massive user acquisition in each market.

**What you'll build and own**

- Own new sender growth across active LATAM markets, setting the strategy for each country based on community behaviour, competitive dynamics, and channel economics.
- Run paid growth: brief the performance marketing team, interpret CAC, CTR, and conversion data daily, and make fast decisions on campaigns, creatives, and spend allocation.
- Manage organic and community channels, including agency and influencer relationships, directing output rather than executing it yourself.
- Act as the product voice for the region: use data to identify drop-off points (KYC friction, latency, onboarding gaps) and push clearly reasoned improvements to the product team.
- Build the market-entry playbook for each new LATAM country, mapping community geography, competitor landscape, and the right channel mix before launch.
- Decide when to hire or bring in external resources for a market, and make the case with data to support it.
- Use AI tools to speed up your own analysis, campaign briefing, and competitor research, and hold yourself to the standard of always validating the output before acting on it.

**Your experience**

- 5+ years of experience in growth, sales, field marketing, or community-led roles.
- Proven track record in growth at a fintech, remittance, or consumer tech company, having owned meaningful KPIs (new users, CAC, conversion) across multiple channels at the same time.
- Deep familiarity with LATAM diaspora communities, including the US-based corridors, and a genuine understanding of how community behaviour differs by market (not just in theory).
- Hands-on experience managing paid campaigns and reading performance data, with a clear instinct for when to scale, when to pause, and why.
- Managed an 8-figure annual growth budget, making spend decisions with accountability for the outcome.
- Strong enough on data to diagnose product and funnel problems yourself, not just brief an analyst. You can pull a report, spot the anomaly, and form a view.
- Experience managing agencies or external partners and getting strong output from them without micromanaging.
- Comfortable operating in a fast-scaling, high-ambiguity environment where the brief changes and the answer is rarely handed to you.

**Nice to have**

- Direct experience launching a product or channel in one or more of Colombia, Mexico, or Guatemala.
- Existing network within the LATAM growth or fintech ecosystem (operators, agencies, community leaders).
- Fluency in Spanish, particularly in a professional or client-facing context.

Why Join LemFi?

Love shouldn’t be expensive, yet those working hardest for their families often face predatory fees and banking exclusion. We're changing this.

At LemFi, you won’t be just a cog in a machine. Whether designing products, scaling operations, or telling our story, you’ll tackle complex challenges with real, immediate impact. Your work goes beyond metrics - it puts money back in families’ pockets and offers access to the previously excluded. Join us to make a meaningful difference, where high performance is a lifeline for millions.

Full-time

Beam Organics

Senior Growth Marketing Manager

About the Role:

We're looking for a growth marketer who wants to own real channels and see their impact every day. In this role, you'll own the relationship with our Google Ads agency, run our DTC affiliate program end-to-end, own our newsletter channel, and help us scale podcast advertising as that channel ramps back up in the next quarter. You'll sit on a tight-knit growth team alongside the leads for Meta and Influencer, with the autonomy to shape how each of your channels grows. This is a great fit if you love operating across multiple channels rather than going deep on just one, you're confident holding agencies and partners accountable to results, and you're analytical enough to spot what's working (and what isn't) without waiting to be told.

What You’ll Do

- Own paid search performance and agency management, optimizing campaigns against ROAS and CAC goals
- Lead the DTC affiliate and newsletter program, growing high-quality partnerships that drive incremental revenue and customer acquisition
- Build cross-channel performance reporting and surface insights that inform growth strategy and optimization priorities
- Test and scale tactics such as copy, landing pages, and CRO as it relates to these acquisition channels.

Who You Are

- 3–6+ years of growth or performance marketing experience (DTC / e-commerce strongly preferred); level and experience level will flex with title
- Hands-on experience managing paid search / Google Ads, either directly or through an agency, with a demonstrated track record on ROAS/CAC
- Experience owning at least one of: affiliate program management, email/newsletter marketing, or podcast advertising — ideally more than one
- Comfortable holding agencies and external partners accountable to deliverables and KPIs
- Analytical: can pull data, build performance reporting, and translate it into channel decisions without needing a dedicated analyst

Location : Boston, MA or New York, NY (Hybrid, 3 days/week in-office) or Remote

We offer:

✔ Fully covered medical benefits + dependent contributions

✔ Unlimited PTO

✔ 401k with up to 4% match

✔ “Work from Anywhere” bank

✔ Wellness stipend for health & fitness

✔ Commuter benefits

These are the Values that Guide our Decisions in the Business:

People First

We take care of ourselves, our teammates and our customers equally

Constant Improvement

Small daily improvements and a commitment to innovation and growth in our personal lives, as well as throughout the business

Transparent and Open Communication

Say it straight or it comes out crooked- respectful and direct communication always

Ego is the Enemy

Always stay humble, hungry, and curious

Think Like an Owner

How are my actions or this moment going to affect the big picture?

Risk Taking

Make informed bets and emotionally move on from the ones that don’t work

Creativity and Rapid Iteration

Think big, fail fast and inexpensively
