**Luxury Presence** is building the AI growth platform for real estate. Backed by Bessemer Venture Partners and other top investors, we’re a Series C company that has hit $100M in annual recurring revenue. More than 90,000 real estate professionals, including over 30% of the WSJ Real Trends top 100 agents in the United States, use us to run and grow their business.

### **About the Role**

Social is one of the most visible surfaces of the LP brand, and it’s ready for a strategic owner. You’ll set the direction for how LP shows up across every platform, from LinkedIn to Reddit, and turn that presence into a real growth channel rather than a content calendar that runs on its own.

This is a build role. You’ll define the strategy, prove that social drives pipeline, and make the function a reliable partner to the rest of marketing. You’ll work closely with our CEO on his thought leadership presence and with content, demand gen, and sales on campaigns that need social to land.

### **What You’ll Do**

- Build and publish a documented social strategy within your first 90 days: channel priorities, content pillars, posting cadence, and voice guidelines, reviewed quarterly against performance data.

- Own a quarterly social-sourced pipeline target, set jointly with sales and RevOps, and build the reporting that shows a clear line between social activity and business results.

- Grow share of voice for LP’s core narrative through follower growth, reach, and impressions on flagship content, including our CEO’s thought leadership and our Reddit presence.

- Manage community health end to end: engagement rate, response time, and sentiment, with a clear before-and-after benchmark from your first day.

- Make social a dependable contributor to at least one other function’s goals within your first year, such as the newsletter’s social section, video series distribution, or webinar promotion, with a documented handoff process.

- Own real-time judgment calls. Reddit threads and comment sections move fast, and there’s no playbook for every scenario. You’ll decide when to engage, when to escalate, and how to protect the brand without waiting for direction.


### **What We’re Looking For**

### **Skills and Experience**

- 4-6 years in social media or community management, with at least 2 years owning strategy rather than executing someone else’s calendar.

- Deep working knowledge of how platforms actually behave, not a one-size-fits-all approach to LinkedIn, Instagram, Reddit, YouTube, and TikTok.

- Comfortable pulling and interpreting engagement, reach, and conversion data, and adjusting strategy based on what the numbers say.

- Strong brand voice discipline. You can make LP sound like LP everywhere, including in fast-moving, informal spaces like Reddit.

- Hands-on content creation or art direction skill, whether that’s producing content yourself or briefing designers and videographers effectively.


### **Attributes**

- You operate as a strategic owner of the function, not an execution arm. You spot opportunities and act on them rather than waiting to be asked.

- You have strong judgment under ambiguity. When something goes sideways in public, you own it end to end.

- You hold a high quality bar even at volume. Social is often a prospect’s first touchpoint with LP, and you know sloppy content undercuts the brand.

- You work fluidly across functions. Social touches nearly everything else in marketing, and you’re comfortable coordinating with content, demand gen, sales, and leadership.

- You stay ahead of platform shifts and cultural moments instead of catching up to them weeks later.

# Senior Marketing Analyst

$156.08k - $195.1k

Temporary

[Oakland, CA](https://jooble.org/jobs/Oakland%2C-CA)

[Apply](https://jooble.org/away/8329790149905346910?p=1&pos=0&rgn=5907&pageType=7&jobAge=742&jdpSource=101&jdpid=-9052497669624173991&crId=US_0US_0)

From Fivetran’s founding until now, our mission has remained the same: to make access to data as simple and reliable as electricity. With Fivetran, customer data arrives in their warehouses, canonical and ready to query, with no engineering or maintenance required. We’re proud that more organizations continue to leverage our technology every day to become truly data-driven.

**About Us**

Fivetran and dbt Labs are bringing together two industry-leading companies with a shared mission: helping organizations unlock the full value of their data.

Together, we’re delivering the data infrastructure layer that helps organizations move, transform, and trust their data — from the moment data moves, through every transformation, to the context teams and AI systems rely on.

Fivetran helps organizations automate data movement across the systems, clouds, engines, and tools they rely on. dbt Labs pioneered analytics engineering, helping teams transform data into reliable, governed insights. Together, we support thousands of organizations as they build a trusted foundation for analytics, AI, and better business decisions.

As we bring our teams and technology together, we’re building on the strengths of both companies while continuing to deliver the products and experiences our customers know and trust. It’s an exciting time to join us: we’re creating a company with the scale, talent, and technology to help more organizations put their data to work with greater speed, confidence, and impact.

During this transition period, you may see references to both Fivetran and dbt Labs throughout our recruiting process as we integrate our teams, systems, and career sites.

## **About the Role**

Fivetran is building data pipelines to power the modern data stack for thousands of companies.We are looking for a Senior Marketing Analyst to help Fivetran make clear, confident decisions about marketing performance. You will connect campaign and channel activity to funnel outcomes and business results, explain what is changing and why, and recommend where teams should focus next. Your work will support decisions across demand generation, digital, field and partner marketing, product-led growth, and the broader go-to-market organization.You will partner with marketing leaders, Finance, Marketing Operations, GTM Strategy, and Analytics to answer high-impact questions, improve how performance is measured, and make reliable insights easier to access. This role is a fit for an analyst who can move from an ambiguous question to a rigorous analysis and a clear recommendation, while building durable metrics, models, and reporting along the way.

This is a full-time, flexible hybrid position based in Oakland, CA. Our hybrid work model offers remote flexibility and in-person collaboration; there is no fixed number of required office days, and we encourage teams to meet in person regularly.

## Technologies You’ll Use

- SQL (BigQuery / Snowflake)
- dbt / dbt State
- Looker / LookML
- Sigma / Hex / Google Sheets
- Claude Code / Codex
- Salesforce, Marketo, web analytics, and marketing attribution data

## What You’ll Do

- **Define and own our core marketing metrics.** Establish clear definitions and reporting across areas such as demand generation, funnel conversion, pipeline, campaign performance, channel efficiency, and marketing’s contribution to revenue.
- **Build scalable analytical products.** Create canonical datasets, models, and self-service tools and dashboards that help Marketing teams and leaders answer important questions quickly and consistently.
- **Serve as a trusted thought partner.** Translate analyses into clear narratives and recommendations for audiences ranging from marketing operators to senior executives. Partner with Engineering and Marketing Operations to improve the quality and usability of data from CRM, marketing automation, web analytics, and attribution systems.
- **Set a high bar for responsible Marketing Analytics.** Establish strong practices for data quality, integrity, governance, privacy, appropriate access, and responsible use of customer and prospect data.
- **Turn marketing data into decisions.** Analyze complex and disparate datasets to identify trends, surface opportunities, and recommend actions to improve campaign performance, funnel conversion, and marketing investment.
- **Shape our analytics culture.** Mentor analysts and partners, establish analytical best practices, and help Marketing teams build stronger data fluency and decision-making habits.

## Skills We’re Looking For

- 5+ years of experience in analytics, data science, business intelligence, or a related analytical role
- Advanced proficiency in SQL and data modeling, with experience working across large, complex datasets
- Experience using Looker, Omni, Tableau, Sigma, or similar business intelligence and visualization tools
- Strong analytical judgment and a track record of translating ambiguous business questions into structured analyses and actionable recommendations
- Exceptional attention to detail and a high bar for data quality, analytical rigor, and reproducibility
- Excellent communication and data storytelling skills; you can make complex findings intuitive and help decision-makers understand not just what is happening, but why it matters and what to do next
- Comfort operating in ambiguity, developing hypotheses, and owning analytical problems end-to-end
- Strong cross-functional instincts and the ability to build trusted relationships with both technical and non-technical partners
- A builder mindset: you look beyond answering one-off questions and create frameworks, datasets, and tools that make future decisions faster and better
- Passion for using data to improve marketing effectiveness and inform go-to-market decisions.
- Experience using analytics to support key business decisions, preferably at a high-growth, SaaS, or B2B product company

## Bonus Skills​

- Experience in Marketing Analytics, demand generation analytics, growth analytics, marketing operations, or another marketing-related analytical function.
- Familiarity with CRM, marketing automation, attribution, web analytics, or product analytics systems such as Salesforce, Marketo, GA4, or Bizible.

Product Manager – BigTime Software – Job Chicago, IL Product Manager BigTime Software • Chicago, Illinois, US Search for other jobs Job title Location Find jobs Product Manager Phoenix, US Job description About BigTime BigTime is a PSA platform built for professional services firms. Our customers use BigTime to scope and sell work, staff it, track time and expense, bill their clients, and see where their margin actually comes from. Thousands of consulting, IT, engineering, and accounting firms run their business on the platform. We are building the next generation of that platform, organized into cross-functional pods that own a product surface end to end. This role leads one of the heaviest of them. About the Role The Financial Core pod owns the accounting engine underneath the platform: the project accounting subledger, the cost model, revenue recognition, WIP and unbilled balances, period close, and the integrations that tie all of it back to a firm's general ledger. This is the surface a controller reconciles against and an auditor has to accept. When it is right, a firm can confidently run its finances with us. When it is wrong, finance stays in spreadsheets and deals stall in evaluation. The pod carries real demand from day one, and the person leading it will be making calls that shape the platform for years. You will own the roadmap, the specification quality, and the outcome for that surface, working alongside an engineering lead, a designer, and a team of engineers who sit with you. This is also an underlying foundational layer for our next generation, AI-native platform. You will have the opportunity to build something brand new, while leveraging the expertise, data, customer knowledge and codebase from our existing platform. What You Will Own The project accounting subledger. Trial balance, subledger detail, aging, GL reconciliation, and the controls around period open, soft close, and hard close. Revenue recognition. ASC 606 support covering performance obligations, transaction price allocation, and recognition by method, including percent complete on cost, hours, or progress, along with milestone, ratable, and on-invoice. The cost model. Employee cost, contractor cost, vendor and pass-through spend, and the margin visibility that sits on top of all of it. WIP, unbilled, and deferred balances treated as reportable, reconcilable objects rather than numbers derived at report time. GL and ERP integrations. Starting with QuickBooks and extending to the major mid-market and enterprise accounting systems, with bidirectional reconciliation and error handling a finance team can trust. AI-native finance workflows. Agents that run the recognition cycle, drive the close checklist, reconcile subledger to GL, and explain every exception in language an accountant accepts. What You Will Do Write specifications precise enough that an engineer can build from them and a controller would recognize them as correct. Your written work is the artifact the pod aligns on. Spend real time with controllers, CFOs, revenue accountants, and accounting managers at services firms, then turn what you hear into requirements with defensible priority. Track regulatory and accounting-standard changes on an ongoing basis, and represent their downstream compliance impact in roadmap decisions. Make the prioritization calls for your surface and defend them with evidence rather than volume. Partner daily with engineering and design inside and across pods. Trade-offs get settled in the room, not through an approval chain. Define acceptance criteria, including for agent behavior, and hold the quality line before anything ships to a customer close cycle. Work closely with Sales, Customer Experience, and Finance so the roadmap reflects what wins deals and what keeps customers. Own the financial contract other pods build against, and review any feature across the platform that creates or changes financial data. What We Are Looking For Product Management Foundation 6+ years of product management for the PM level, or 4+ years for the Senior PM level, on a B2B SaaS product with genuine domain depth. A track record of shipping complex, backend-heavy capability that customers adopted, not just features that launched. Strong written communication. You can hold a position in a document and change your mind in public when the evidence moves. Comfort operating with ambiguity and a bias toward getting to a decision quickly. Experience working directly with engineering on data models and system design, and enough technical fluency to be useful in that conversation. You work AI-native. AI is part of how you do the job, not a topic you have opinions about. That means pulling signals from several data sources at once, standing up a working prototype yourself instead of waiting on a design cycle, and using AI to draft and maintain PRDs, specs, competitive analysis, and customer research synthesis. Come ready to show us what you have built this way. Finance and Accounting Background You do not need to have been an accountant, but you do need to understand how firms actually close their books. Any one of these gets you a conversation: ERP or accounting platform implementation, solution consulting, or solution architecture, where you configured a chart of accounts, revenue recognition, or the close process for real clients. NetSuite, Sage Intacct, Microsoft Dynamics, Workday Financials, Deltek, Unanet, and QuickBooks all count. This is the most common path into this role and we weigh it heavily. Product management on a financial product, such as a subledger, revenue recognition engine, billing system, close platform, or reconciliation tooling. Hands-on accounting or finance operations experience, as a staff accountant, revenue accountant, controller, or in FP&A, with a working command of the general ledger and a move into software already behind you or clearly underway. A CPA, CMA, or accounting degree is relevant and we will weigh it, though none of them is required. The job requires that you understand what belongs in a subledger versus the GL, how percent-complete recognition behaves when the estimate changes, what a period close involves week to week, and why an auditor cares about the difference between an adjusting entry and an edit. If you are most of the way there, apply. We would rather teach the remainder than hire someone who has to learn all of it. Deep domain background is critical here. If you have run financial system implementations for years and have less time in a formal product role, we want to see your application. Helpful, Not Required Background in professional services, consulting, agency, or architecture and engineering firms. Experience with multi-entity, multi-currency, intercompany, or transfer pricing. Work on AI or agent-driven features inside an audited or regulated workflow. You have shipped your own pull requests, or worked with engineering through spec-driven and agentic development where the specification feeds the build directly.
